# ── MAPLEAD provider keys ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Copy this file to `.env` (same folder as maplead.py) and fill in ONE key.
# Any key you add is auto-detected; remove the ones you don't use.

# Outscraper  https://outscraper.com  → richest field set (email, socials, chain data)
OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY=

# Google Places API (New)  https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service
# Enable "Places API (New)" in a GCP project, then enable billing.
GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY=

# SerpApi  https://serpapi.com/google-maps-api
SERPAPI_API_KEY=

# DataForSEO Labs  https://dataforseo.com/apis/google-maps-api
# Credentials come from https://app.dataforseo.com/ > API credentials
DATAFORSEO_LOGIN=
DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD=

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  terminal:
    name: terminal wizard (no dependencies)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.9"

      - name: compile every module
        run: python -m compileall -q maplead

      - name: the CLI must run with nothing installed
        run: |
          python -m pip list --format=freeze | grep -qi pyside && { echo "PySide6 leaked into the CLI path"; exit 1; } || true
          python maplead.py --version
          python maplead.py --demo --country Germany --city Berlin \
            --business dentist --fields rec --limit 60 --format xlsx \
            --min-rating 4.0 --outdir /tmp/maplead-ci
          ls -l /tmp/maplead-ci

      - name: introspection still works
        run: |
          python maplead.py --list-providers
          python maplead.py --list-fields --provider google

  desktop:
    name: desktop app
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: install GUI dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -q "PySide6-Essentials>=6.8" pyflakes

      - name: lint (unused imports / undefined names)
        run: python -m pyflakes maplead tools

      - name: headless self-test
        env:
          QT_QPA_PLATFORM: offscreen
        run: python maplead-gui.py --selftest

name: Release

# Bump VERSION in maplead/art.py, tag, push:
#   git tag v1.1.0 && git push origin v1.1.0

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "tag to build (e.g. v1.0.0)"
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  appimage:
    name: build AppImage (linux x86_64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: system packages for the Qt xcb platform
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            libglib2.0-0 libegl1 libxkbcommon-x11-0 libxcb-cursor0 \
            libdbus-1-3 libfontconfig1 fuse libfuse2 desktop-file-utils

      - name: build + smoke test
        run: ./build-appimage.sh --no-test

      - name: run the built image
        env:
          QT_QPA_PLATFORM: offscreen
        run: |
          APP="$(ls "$HOME/Apps"/MAPLEAD-*.AppImage | head -1)"
          chmod +x "$APP"
          "$APP" --selftest

      - name: describe
        id: meta
        run: |
          TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}"
          APP="$(ls "$HOME/Apps"/MAPLEAD-*.AppImage | head -1)"
          echo "name=MAPLEAD $TAG (x86_64)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "path=$APP" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: attach to the GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}
          name: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.name }}
          body: |
            Linux x86_64 AppImage of MAPLEAD.

            ```bash
            chmod +x MAPLEAD-*-x86_64.AppImage
            ./MAPLEAD-*-x86_64.AppImage
            ```

            If your system has no `libfuse.so.2`, run it with
            `APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1` — it unpacks itself into `~/.maplead-runtime/`
            and runs from there. The user guide covers the rest:
            https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md
          files: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.path }}

# secrets - never commit these
.env
.env.*
!.env.example

# build / runtime artefacts
build/
dist/
.venv-gui/
__pycache__/
*.pyc
*.pyo

# lead exports
leads/*.csv
leads/*.xlsx
leads/*.json
leads/*.html
leads/*.txt
leads/*.tsv

# generated icons (rebuilt by packaging/render_icon.py)
packaging/maplead-*.png
packaging/maplead.png

# Changelog

All notable changes to MAPLEAD. Format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/).

## [1.0.0] — 2026-10-17

### Added
- **Qt6 desktop app** (`maplead/gui/`) — the nine wizard answers as one form,
  live stat tiles, a sortable/filterable results grid, a colour-coded activity log,
  a searchable 35-field picker that locks fields the chosen provider cannot return,
  and dark/light themes.
- **API key manager window** — paste a key, verify it with a real API call, save it to
  `~/.config/maplead/.env` (mode 600), or remove it. Per-provider status everywhere.
- **AppImage build** — `./build-appimage.sh [--install]` produces a single
  `~/Apps/MAPLEAD-<version>-x86_64.AppImage`, bundles the small X11 libraries desktops
  often lack, and smoke-tests the result.
- **No-FUSE launcher** — `~/Apps/maplead` unpacks the image once into
  `~/.maplead-runtime/` and runs it from there when `libfuse.so.2` is missing.
- `--gui` on the CLI launcher; `maplead-gui.py`; `--selftest` for a headless check.
- `maplead/paths.py` — XDG-aware config/data locations shared by both front-ends.
- User guide, development notes, contributing guide and CI.

### Changed
- API keys are read from a new XDG location when no `.env` sits next to the tool;
  an existing local `.env` keeps working exactly as before.
- Real environment variables still take precedence over the config file.
- The left-hand form now scrolls and pins the **Run/Stop** button, so the primary
  action is never scrolled out of reach on a small screen.
- Restored window geometry is clamped to the screen it is opened on.

### Fixed
- GUI labels no longer paint a background slab over their card.
- Columns are sized to their content, headers are short, and empty/unmatched states
  have their own message.
- Long lists in the terminal wizard keep their multi-column layout.

### Notes
- Linux x86_64 is the only packaged platform for now; the terminal wizard still runs
  anywhere Python 3.9+ does.

# MAPLEAD **Google Maps lead extractor — a Linux desktop app and a terminal wizard, same engine.** Nine questions, one spreadsheet. Pick a provider, a city, a business type and how many leads you want; MAPLEAD pulls local businesses out of Google Maps through a lead-scraper API and writes them to CSV / Excel / JSON / TXT / TSV / HTML. ![MAPLEAD desktop app](docs/screenshots/app-dark.png) | | | |---|---| | 🖥️ **Desktop app** | Qt6 window, one file, nothing to install — [`MAPLEAD-x86_64.AppImage`](docs/GUIDE.md#1-get-the-app) | | ⌨️ **Terminal wizard** | pure standard-library Python, no dependencies at all | | 🔌 **4 providers** | Outscraper · Google Places · SerpApi · DataForSEO (+ an offline demo) | | 🧭 **65 countries / 1044 cities** | typed, filtered, auto-completed — no spelling games | | 🏷️ **68 business types · 35 fields** | you choose exactly which columns come out | | 📄 **6 export formats** | csv · xlsx · json · txt · tsv · html |

--- ## 1 · Get the app **Linux x86_64, AppImage** — one file, no packages, no root: ```bash chmod +x MAPLEAD-1.0.0-x86_64.AppImage ./MAPLEAD-1.0.0-x86_64.AppImage ``` Building it yourself (also fine for arm64/other distros with a rebuild): ```bash git clone https://github.com/DariusDev16/maplead.git cd maplead ./build-appimage.sh --install # writes ~/Apps/, adds it to your PATH and menu ``` > No FUSE on your system? The launcher handles it: it unpacks the image once into > `~/.maplead-runtime/` and runs from there. No root, no loop device. ## 2 · Add an API key MAPLEAD never scrapes Google directly — it talks to a lead-scraper API you pay for (or a free trial of). In the app: **API keys…** (top right) → paste → **Save & verify** (it makes a real request before saving). Keys live in `~/.config/maplead/.env`, mode 600. | id | service | env var | per query | e-mail / socials | |---|---|---|---|---| | `outscraper` | [Outscraper](https://outscraper.com) | `OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY` | ~200 | ✅ (paid enrichment) | | `google` | [Google Places API (New)](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service) | `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` | 60 | ❌ | | `serpapi` | [SerpApi](https://serpapi.com/google-maps-api) | `SERPAPI_API_KEY` | ~140 | ❌ | | `dataforseo` | [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/apis/google-maps-api) | `DATAFORSEO_LOGIN` + `…_PASSWORD` | ~300 | ❌ | | `demo` | built in | – | 120 | ✅ (synthetic) | **No key yet?** Run it in **Demo** mode: synthetic leads, no network, nothing to pay — perfect to try the whole thing first. ## 3 · Run a search Fill the form on the left, press **Run search** (or `Ctrl+R`), watch the activity log. Results land in a sortable grid; double-click a row to open it in Google Maps, right-click to copy it straight into Sheets. ![the nine answers](docs/screenshots/terminal.png) Everything is filtered *after every batch*, so a strict `--min-rating` still fills your quota, and duplicates are removed on `place_id` (falling back to name + address). ## 4 · Get the file Files land in `~/Documents/maplead/` with a timestamped name. **xlsx** has a frozen header, auto-filter and a `Meta` sheet with the search parameters; **csv/tsv** are UTF-8 (BOM, so Excel keeps the accents); **json** keeps types and arrays. ![harvest report](docs/screenshots/terminal-report.png) --- ## Terminal wizard Same engine, zero dependencies, Python 3.9+: ```bash ./maplead.py # guided: 9 questions ./maplead.py --api # set + verify an API key ./maplead.py --demo # try it with no key at all ./maplead.py --gui # …or open the desktop app # scriptable ./maplead.py --demo \ --country "United States" --region "Texas" --city "Austin" \ --business "plumber" --fields sales --limit 150 --format xlsx \ --min-rating 4.2 --require-phone --skip-closed --out leads/austin.xlsx ``` | flag | meaning | |---|---| | `-k`, `--api` | key setup: paste, verify live, save | | `--check-keys` / `--remove-keys` | test / wipe stored keys | | `--provider` | force a provider instead of auto-detecting | | `--country` `--region` `--city` | location (`DE`, `Germany`, `deutschland`…) | | `--business` | vertical or free text (`"solar installer"`) | | `--fields` | `name,phone,rating` · `rec` · `basic` · `sales` · `all` | | `--limit` `--format` `--out` `--outdir` | volume and destination | | `--min-rating` `--min-reviews` | quality filters | | `--require-phone` `--require-website` `--skip-closed` | hard filters | | `--enrich` | Outscraper contact enrichment (costs credits) | | `--gui` | launch the desktop app | --- ## Screenshots | | | |---|---| | ![first run](docs/screenshots/first-run.png) | ![api keys](docs/screenshots/api-keys.png) | | Empty first run — Demo mode is ready before you add a key | Keys window: paste, verify, save | More detail in **[docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md)** (user guide) and **[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)** (architecture, build, release). ## Status Linux is the only supported platform for now (AppImage). The terminal wizard runs anywhere Python 3.9+ does. macOS/Windows packaging is on the roadmap. ## Legal Lead data returned by these APIs is public business information. Respect each provider's terms and rate limits, and your GDPR/LGPD/PCCB obligations before cold-contacting anyone. MAPLEAD never edits Google Maps — it only reads what the provider APIs already expose. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 MAPLEAD contributors.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Build MAPLEAD Desktop into a single-file AppImage (Linux x86_64).
#
#   ./build-appimage.sh              build + smoke test
#   ./build-appimage.sh --no-test    build only
#
# Requires: python3 >= 3.10, ~1.5 GB of disk for the Qt bundle.
# Everything is installed into the project-local .venv-gui - no sudo, no
# system packages touched.

set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

VENV="$ROOT/.venv-gui"
PY="$VENV/bin/python"
BUILD="$ROOT/build"
DIST="$ROOT/dist"
APPDIR="$BUILD/maplead.AppDir"
# The AppImage is a *product*, not source: it is written OUTSIDE the project so
# `git clean`, `rm -rf` or a stray cleanup never eat it.
OUTDIR="${MAPLEAD_OUTDIR:-$HOME/Apps}"
NAME="MAPLEAD"
BIN_NAME="maplead"
ICON_NAME="maplead"
ARCH="${ARCH:-x86_64}"
DESKTOP_ID="io.github.maplead.Desktop"
TOOLS="$BUILD/tools"
APPIMAGETOOL="$TOOLS/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage"

VERSION="$(python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib
print(re.search(r'VERSION = "([^"]+)"',
                pathlib.Path("maplead/art.py").read_text()).group(1))
PY
)"

RUN_TEST=1
DO_INSTALL=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --no-test) RUN_TEST=0 ;;
    --install) DO_INSTALL=1 ;;
  esac
done

say() { printf '\n\033[1;36m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }

# locate a shared library by soname without ldconfig (not present in minimal images)
find_lib() {
  local so="$1"
  for dir in /lib/"$(uname -m)"-linux-gnu /usr/lib/"$(uname -m)"-linux-gnu \
             /lib64 /usr/lib64 /usr/lib /lib /usr/local/lib; do
    if [[ -e "$dir/$so" ]]; then
      printf '%s' "$dir/$so"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "1/7  python environment"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
if [[ ! -x "$PY" ]]; then
  python3 -m venv "$VENV" || true
  if ! "$PY" -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # Debian splits ensurepip into python3-venv; bootstrap pip by hand
    tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
    curl -sSL -o "$tmp/get-pip.py" https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py
    "$PY" "$tmp/get-pip.py" -q
    rm -rf "$tmp"
  fi
fi
if ! "$PY" -c "import PySide6" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip
  "$PY" -m pip install -q "PySide6-Essentials>=6.8" pyinstaller
fi
"$PY" -c "import PySide6; from PySide6 import QtCore; print('    PySide6', QtCore.__version__)"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "2/7  icons"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
mkdir -p packaging
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen "$PY" packaging/render_icon.py
cp packaging/maplead-512.png packaging/maplead.png

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "3/7  desktop entry"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
mkdir -p "$BUILD"
# inside an AppDir the launcher is AppRun - the desktop tools swap it for the
# real AppImage path when the file is installed
sed -e "s|^Exec=.*|Exec=AppRun|" \
    -e "s|^Icon=.*|Icon=$ICON_NAME|" \
    -e "s|^TryExec=.*|TryExec=AppRun|" \
    packaging/maplead.desktop > "$BUILD/$ICON_NAME.desktop"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "4/7  pyinstaller (this is the slow part)"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
rm -rf "$DIST/maplead" "$ROOT/build/maplead"
"$PY" -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean \
    --distpath "$DIST" --workpath "$BUILD/work" \
    packaging/maplead.spec

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "5/7  AppDir"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
rm -rf "$APPDIR"
mkdir -p "$APPDIR/usr/bin" "$APPDIR/usr/lib" \
         "$APPDIR/usr/share/applications" \
         "$APPDIR/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps" \
         "$APPDIR/usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps" \
         "$APPDIR/usr/share/maplead"

cp -a "$DIST/maplead" "$APPDIR/usr/lib/$BIN_NAME"
cp packaging/maplead.svg "$APPDIR/usr/share/maplead/"
cp packaging/maplead.png "$APPDIR/$ICON_NAME.png"
cp packaging/maplead-256.png "$APPDIR/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/$ICON_NAME.png"
cp packaging/maplead-512.png "$APPDIR/usr/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/$ICON_NAME.png"
cp "$BUILD/$ICON_NAME.desktop" "$APPDIR/$ICON_NAME.desktop"
ln -sf "../$ICON_NAME.desktop" "$APPDIR/usr/share/applications/$ICON_NAME.desktop"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "5b/7 bundling the small libs desktops tend to be missing"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Qt loads its X11/wayland plugins through libqxcb.so, whose DT_NEEDED list is
# not satisfied on a bare Ubuntu/Fedora box. These are all tiny, permissively
# licensed and identical across distros, so ship them inside the AppImage.
LIBDIR="$APPDIR/usr/lib/$BIN_NAME/lib"
mkdir -p "$LIBDIR"
BUNDLED=0
for so in libEGL.so.1 libGL.so.1 libGLdispatch.so.0 libGLX.so.0 \
          libxcb-cursor.so.0 libxcb-icccm.so.4 libxcb-image.so.0 libxcb-keysyms.so.1 \
          libxcb-randr.so.0 libxcb-render-util.so.0 libxcb-shape.so.0 \
          libxcb-xinerama.so.0 libxcb-xkb.so.1 libxkbcommon-x11.so.0 \
          libX11-xcb.so.1 libb2.so.1 libmd4c.so.0 libdrm.so.2; do
  src="$(find_lib "$so" || true)"
  if [[ -n "$src" ]]; then
    cp -L "$src" "$LIBDIR/$so"
    BUNDLED=$((BUNDLED + 1))
  fi
done
echo "    $BUNDLED extra libraries bundled"

# nothing critical left dangling?
if command -v ldd >/dev/null; then
  missing=$(LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$APPDIR/usr/lib/$BIN_NAME:$LIBDIR" \
            ldd "$APPDIR/usr/lib/$BIN_NAME/PySide6/Qt/plugins/platforms/libqxcb.so" 2>/dev/null \
            | awk '/not found/ {print $1}' | sort -u || true)
  if [[ -n "$missing" ]]; then
    echo "    note: still resolved from the host system: $(echo "$missing" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
fi

# AppRun: keep the Qt plugins on the library path, then exec the frozen app
cat > "$APPDIR/AppRun" <<'APPRUN'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# MAPLEAD Desktop - AppImage entry point
HERE="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "${0}")")"
APPDIR="$HERE/usr/lib/maplead"
export PATH="${APPDIR}:${PATH}"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${APPDIR}/lib:${APPDIR}:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export QT_PLUGIN_PATH="${APPDIR}/PySide6/plugins:${QT_PLUGIN_PATH}"
export XDG_DATA_DIRS="${HERE}/usr/share:${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}"
export QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR="${QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR:-1}"
exec "${APPDIR}/maplead" "$@"
APPRUN
chmod +x "$APPDIR/AppRun"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "6/7  appimagetool"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
mkdir -p "$TOOLS"
if [[ ! -x "$APPIMAGETOOL" ]]; then
  echo "    downloading appimagetool…"
  curl -sSL -o "$APPIMAGETOOL" \
    https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/releases/download/continuous/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage
  chmod +x "$APPIMAGETOOL"
fi

mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
OUT="$OUTDIR/${NAME}-${VERSION}-${ARCH}.AppImage"

# appimagetool needs FUSE; containers usually do not, so fall back to extract+run
run_appimagetool() {
  ARCH="$ARCH" "$APPIMAGETOOL" --no-appstream "$APPDIR" "$OUT"
}
if ! run_appimagetool 2>"$BUILD/appimage.log"; then
  echo "    retrying without FUSE…"
  APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 run_appimagetool
fi
chmod +x "$OUT"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
say "7/7  smoke test"
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
ls -lh "$OUT"
if [[ "$RUN_TEST" == "1" ]]; then
  run_app() { "$@" --selftest; }
  if ! run_app "$OUT" >"$BUILD/selftest.log" 2>&1; then
    if ! APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 run_app "$OUT" >"$BUILD/selftest.log" 2>&1; then
      echo "!! selftest failed:"; tail -30 "$BUILD/selftest.log"; exit 1
    fi
  fi
  tail -12 "$BUILD/selftest.log"
fi

say "done"

if [[ "$DO_INSTALL" == "1" ]]; then
  # --- launcher + PATH + application menu -------------------------------- #
  bin="${XDG_BIN_HOME:-$HOME/.local/bin}"
  apps="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}"
  mkdir -p "$bin" "$apps/applications" \
           "$apps/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps" "$apps/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps"

  # a wrapper that copes with machines that have no libfuse2
  LAUNCHER="$OUTDIR/$BIN_NAME"
  sed -e "s|@APP@|$OUT|g" -e "s|@CACHE@|$OUTDIR/.$BIN_NAME-runtime|g" \
      packaging/launcher.sh > "$LAUNCHER"
  chmod +x "$LAUNCHER"

  # symlink, not a copy: one single file to keep up to date
  rm -f "$bin/$BIN_NAME"
  ln -s "$LAUNCHER" "$bin/$BIN_NAME"

  sed -e "s|^Exec=.*|Exec=$LAUNCHER|" \
      -e "s|^TryExec=.*|TryExec=$LAUNCHER|" \
      packaging/maplead.desktop > "$apps/applications/$DESKTOP_ID.desktop"
  install -m 644 packaging/maplead-512.png "$apps/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps/$ICON_NAME.png"
  install -m 644 packaging/maplead-256.png "$apps/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/$ICON_NAME.png"
  if command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    update-desktop-database "$apps/applications" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  echo "  instalado:  $OUT"
  echo "  lançador:   $LAUNCHER"
  echo "  no PATH:    $bin/$BIN_NAME -> $LAUNCHER"
  echo "  no menu:    MAPLEAD"
fi

cat <<EOF

  $OUT

  rodar:     $bin/$BIN_NAME     (após --install)
            ou dê dois cliques no atalho MAPLEAD do menu
  sem FUSE:  o lançador descompacta o AppImage em $OUTDIR/.$BIN_NAME-runtime
            e roda dali - nenhuma permissão especial necessária
  chaves:    ~/.config/maplead/.env
  exports:   ~/Documents/maplead/

EOF

# Contributing to MAPLEAD

Thanks for helping out. This is a small, friendly codebase — the bar is "would this
be obvious to the next person reading it in a year?".

## Ground rules

1. **The terminal wizard stays dependency-free.** `maplead.py`, `maplead/cli.py` and
   everything they import must run on a bare Python 3.9+. PySide6 belongs in
   `maplead/gui/` only. A CI job enforces this.
2. **`engine.py` stays UI-agnostic.** It takes a plan, calls providers, returns
   `(leads, report)`. Progress and cancellation are callbacks.
3. **Never commit secrets.** `.env` is gitignored. Keys belong in
   `~/.config/maplead/.env` (mode 600) or in the environment.
4. **No new runtime dependencies** in the engine/exporters. The xlsx writer, the HTTP
   client and the TUI are all hand-rolled on the standard library for exactly this
   reason.

## Getting set up

```bash
git clone https://github.com/DariusDev16/maplead.git && cd maplead

# terminal wizard: nothing to install
./maplead.py --demo

# desktop app
python3 -m venv .venv-gui
.venv-gui/bin/python -m pip install PySide6-Essentials pyinstaller
```

## Architecture

One engine, two front-ends.

```
                 ┌──────────────┐        ┌──────────────┐
   terminal  ───▶│ maplead.cli  │        │ maplead.gui  │───▶ Qt6 window
                 │ (stdlib TUI) │        │ (PySide6)    │
                 └──────┬───────┘        └──────┬───────┘
                        │                       │ QThread
                        └───────────┬───────────┘
                                    ▼
                            maplead.engine        query planning, harvest, dedupe, filters
                                    │
             ┌──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
             ▼                      ▼                      ▼
      maplead.providers      maplead.data          maplead.exporters
   Google/Outscraper/SerpApi  countries, cities,   csv tsv json xlsx txt html
   DataForSEO/demo           verticals, fields    (xlsx written by hand)
                                    │
                              maplead.net         urllib client: retries, backoff
```

Rules that keep it honest:

- **`engine.py` knows nothing about pixels.** It takes a `SearchPlan`, calls a
  provider, and returns `(leads, HarvestReport)`. Progress is a callback; cancellation
  is a `should_stop()` callback. That is the whole contract with both front-ends.
- **Providers normalise.** Every provider returns the same lead dict shape
  (`providers._blank()`), so exporters and the table never special-case a source.
- **Field availability is declared, not guessed.** Each field in `data/fields.py`
  lists the providers that can return it; both front-ends use that list to grey out
  what is impossible instead of silently exporting empty columns.
- **The CLI keeps zero dependencies.** `maplead.py` must run on a bare Python 3.9+
  with nothing installed. Only `maplead/gui/` may import PySide6.

## Layout

```
maplead.py              terminal launcher
maplead-gui.py          desktop launcher
maplead/
  cli.py                terminal wizard, flags, reporting
  engine.py             query planning, harvesting, dedupe, filters
  providers.py          Google / Outscraper / SerpApi / DataForSEO / demo
  exporters.py          csv tsv json xlsx txt html (hand-rolled xlsx writer)
  net.py                urllib JSON client: retries, backoff, error extraction
  ui.py                 terminal prompts, multi-column lists, tables, progress
  art.py                ASCII/Unicode art, colours, gradients
  paths.py              XDG config/data locations, .env load/save/clear
  data/                 countries · cities · verticals · field catalogue
  gui/
    app.py              entry point, theme bootstrap, --selftest
    main_window.py      window: form, stats, table, activity log
    widgets.py          cards, searchable combo, field picker, table model
    keys.py             API key manager (paste · verify live · save)
    worker.py           harvest + key validation on a QThread
    icons.py            inline SVG icon set (no image files)
    theme.py            dark/light palettes and the stylesheet
packaging/              icon (svg+png), .desktop file, PyInstaller spec, launcher
tools/screenshots.py    regenerates docs/screenshots/*
build-appimage.sh       one-command AppImage build (+ optional --install)
docs/                   user guide, development notes and screenshots
```

## Running from source

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv-gui && .venv-gui/bin/python -m pip install PySide6-Essentials

./maplead.py --demo        # terminal wizard (needs no venv at all)
./maplead-gui.py           # desktop
./maplead-gui.py --selftest
```

On Debian, `python3 -m venv` sometimes ships without `ensurepip`; bootstrap pip with
`get-pip.py` (the build script does this for you).

## Building the AppImage

```bash
./build-appimage.sh                 # build + smoke test
./build-appimage.sh --install       # …and install to ~/.local/bin + app menu
./build-appimage.sh --no-test       # skip the smoke test
MAPLEAD_OUTDIR=~/bin ./build-appimage.sh      # somewhere else
```

What it does, in order:

1. creates/updates `.venv-gui` (PySide6-Essentials + PyInstaller);
2. renders the PNG icons from `packaging/maplead.svg` (Qt does the rasterising — no
   ImageMagick, no Pillow);
3. generates the `.desktop` entry (`Exec=AppRun`, replaced at install time);
4. runs PyInstaller with `packaging/maplead.spec` — a `onedir` build, because startup
   speed matters more than a single file once we are already inside a squashfs;
5. assembles an AppDir (`usr/lib/maplead`, icons, desktop file) and copies the small
   X11/GL libraries desktops tend to lack;
6. runs `appimagetool` to produce `~/Apps/MAPLEAD-<version>-x86_64.AppImage`;
7. runs the self-test **inside** the produced image.

### Trimming the bundle

`packaging/maplead.spec` excludes the Qt modules the app never imports (QML, Quick,
WebEngine, Multimedia, 3D, Charts, Sql, …), which takes the bundle from ~300 MB to
~160 MB uncompressed. Add to `EXCLUDES` freely; re-run the self-test afterwards to be
sure nothing was needed after all.

## The no-FUSE launcher

`packaging/launcher.sh` becomes `~/Apps/maplead`. It checks for `libfuse.so.2`
(`ldconfig -p`, then the usual library directories), and when it is missing unpacks the
AppImage once with `--appimage-extract` into `~/.maplead-runtime/` and runs its
`AppRun`. The cache is invalidated by comparing timestamps against the image.

## Self-test

`maplead-gui --selftest` runs headless (`QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` works, a real
display is optional) and verifies: the window builds, the demo engine returns leads,
the xlsx is written, the table model matches the result set, the searchable combo
filters, the field picker applies presets and locks unavailable fields, and the keys
dialog renders every provider. This is what CI runs and what the build script runs
against the finished AppImage.

```bash
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen ./maplead-gui.py --selftest
MAPLEAD_DEBUG=1 ./maplead-gui.py --selftest     # full tracebacks
```

## Publishing without a system git

Locked-down desktops sometimes have neither a system git nor an SSH client, and
`git push` over HTTPS needs `libcurl-gnutls` matching the local glibc. In that
situation `tools/publish.py` pushes over the REST API with `curl` alone:

```bash
read -rs TOKEN && printf '%s' "$TOKEN" > ~/.maplead-github-token && chmod 600 ~/.maplead-github-token
python3 tools/publish.py --repo maplead      # creates the repo if needed, then pushes
rm -f ~/.maplead-github-token
```

It uploads the files git is tracking (blobs for binaries, inline content for text),
creates the commit and points `main` at it. Re-running is safe.

## CI and releases

- **CI** (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): on push and pull requests — compile-check every
  module, run the terminal demo end to end, and run the GUI self-test with
  `PySide6-Essentials` on Linux.
- **Release** (`.github/workflows/release.yml`): on a `v*` tag — build the AppImage and
  attach it to a GitHub Release. Bump `VERSION` in `maplead/art.py` first; everything
  else (file name, window title, About box) reads from there.

## Adding a provider

1. Subclass `Provider` in `providers.py`: `name`, `label`, `env_keys`, `homepage`,
   `per_query_cap`, `validate()` (a cheap live call) and `search()` returning
   `SearchResult(leads=[...])` filled through `_blank()`.
2. Register it in `PROVIDERS` and `ORDER`.
3. Add its id to the provider tuples in `data/fields.py` for the fields it can return.
4. Nothing else: both front-ends read those three places.

Keep `providers.py` free of printing — the front-ends own all output.

## Regenerating the screenshots

```bash
./.venv-gui/bin/python tools/screenshots.py        # needs a display (DISPLAY=:0)
```

It restores your saved window state afterwards and replaces real API keys with a fake
one before grabbing, so regenerating the docs never leaks a key and never disturbs your
session. Terminal screenshots are produced separately with an `xterm` fullscreen run
piped through `script -qec` (which keeps the colours).

## 1 · Get the app

Download `MAPLEAD-1.0.0-x86_64.AppImage` (Linux x86_64), then:

```bash
chmod +x MAPLEAD-1.0.0-x86_64.AppImage     # first time only
./MAPLEAD-1.0.0-x86_64.AppImage
```

After `./build-appimage.sh --install` you can also just type `maplead`, and the app
appears in your application menu as **MAPLEAD**.

The AppImage bundles Qt and the ~18 small X11 libraries desktops often lack. The
only things it expects from the system are a display and the usual C library.

**No FUSE?** Older AppImages mount themselves through `libfuse.so.2`. If your system
only ships FUSE 3 (or none at all), the `maplead` launcher notices and unpacks the
image once into `~/.maplead-runtime/`, then runs it from there. Nothing else changes,
and the cache refreshes itself when the AppImage is rebuilt.

## 2 · The first launch

![first run](screenshots/first-run.png)

The app opens in **Demo** mode when no API key is configured: synthetic leads, no
network, no cost. Use it to learn the interface, and switch providers later without
losing anything — the form, the window size and the theme are remembered between runs.

## 3 · API keys

![api keys](screenshots/api-keys.png)

**API keys…** in the top-right corner opens the key manager. One row per provider:

| what | why |
|---|---|
| **Get a key** | opens that provider's dashboard in your browser |
| the masked field | paste the key (or the login *and* password, for DataForSEO) |
| **Save & verify** | saves, then makes a **real API call** to prove the key works |
| **Save only** | saves without spending a credit |
| **Remove** | clears the key from the config file |
| **Check all saved keys** | re-tests everything that is configured |

Keys are written to `~/.config/maplead/.env` with mode `600`, and are only ever sent
to the provider you pasted them for. Real environment variables always win over that
file, so exporting `SERPAPI_API_KEY=…` in your shell works too.

## 4 · The search form, field by field

| step | control | notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Data provider** | auto-selects a configured one; shows the key state, the per-query cap and the provider homepage |
| 2-4 | **Where** | country (65, type to filter) → region (with completion) → city (1044 catalogued, type anything) |
| 5 | **What business** | 68 verticals with the phrases they are actually searched as, or free text |
| 6 | **Fields** | 35 fields, grouped and searchable, with `rec` / `basic` / `sales` / `all` presets |
| 7 | **How many + filters** | target volume, min rating, min reviews, phone/website required, skip closed, enrichment |
| 8 | **Export** | csv · xlsx · json · txt · tsv · html, plus the destination path |

Two things worth knowing:

- **Pick the region and the city list narrows to it.** Leave the region empty to
  search the whole country.
- **Fields your provider cannot return are locked**, with the reason shown
  (`· Outscraper`, `· Google Places`…). E-mail and social profiles need Outscraper.

## 5 · Running a search

Press **Run search** or `Ctrl+R`. While it runs:

- the progress bar and the activity log show every query, how many raw results came
  back and how many survived the filters;
- the form is locked so a run cannot be corrupted by a stray click;
- **Stop** (`Ctrl+R` again, or the button) finishes the current query and keeps what
  it already collected — the file is still written.

Because a text query returns at most 60 places from Google (and a few hundred from
the other providers), MAPLEAD widens the net with query variants — synonyms from the
vertical catalogue, `near <location>`, per-district phrasing — until your target is
reached or the variants run out.

## 6 · Reading the results

- **Stat tiles** — leads found vs. target, share with a phone, share with a website,
  average rating, total reviews, elapsed time.
- **Grid** — click any column header to sort; the **filter rows…** box searches every
  visible column at once.
- **Double-click** a row to open that business in Google Maps.
- **Right-click** a row: copy cell, copy row, copy row as TSV (paste straight into
  Sheets/Excel), copy selection as spreadsheet text, open in Maps, open website, or
  search the phone number online.
- **Copy selection** copies the highlighted rows (all columns) to the clipboard.

## 7 · The export file

| format | what you get |
|---|---|
| **xlsx** | real Excel workbook: frozen header, auto-filter, sized columns, numbers as numbers, plus a `Meta` sheet with every search parameter |
| **csv** / **tsv** | UTF-8 with BOM, so Excel and Sheets keep accents and tabs |
| **json** | `{meta, columns, count, leads[]}` with types preserved |
| **txt** | one readable block per lead |
| **html** | dark report with links and star ratings — open it in any browser |

Exactly the fields you selected become columns (unless you picked "everything").

## 8 · Terminal wizard

The original interface, still fully supported and dependency-free:

```bash
./maplead.py --api     # set + verify a key
./maplead.py           # guided
./maplead.py --demo    # no key needed
./maplead.py --gui     # open the desktop app
```

Guided mode shows long lists side by side, sized to your terminal, so the 65
countries and 68 verticals fit on one screen; every list is filterable by typing,
and the field picker understands `1,3-5` ranges and `all` / `none` / `rec`.

Environment switches: `MAPLEAD_NO_COLOR=1`, `MAPLEAD_ASCII=1` (plain output),
`MAPLEAD_DEBUG=1` (full tracebacks).

## 9 · Where files live

| what | path |
|---|---|
| keys | `~/.config/maplead/.env` (mode 600) |
| exports | `~/Documents/maplead/` |
| window state / theme / last form | `~/.local/share/maplead/` |
| unpacked AppImage (no-FUSE systems) | `~/.maplead-runtime/` |

Nothing is written inside the project folder or the AppImage.

## 10 · Troubleshooting

| symptom | cause / fix |
|---|---|
| `dlopen(): error loading libfuse.so.2` | your system has no FUSE 2 — run the `maplead` launcher (not the `.AppImage` directly), or `APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 ./MAPLEAD-….AppImage` |
| blank window / wrong colours | force a theme: `maplead --theme dark` or `--theme light` |
| "no API keys — demo mode available" | expected until you add one in **API keys…** |
| `API key not valid` | the key is wrong for that API — paste the right one (Google's key must have **Places API (New)** enabled and billing on the project) |
| `403` | key rejected: check plan/quota on the provider dashboard |
| `429` | rate limited: wait a minute and run again |
| "got 60 of the 150 you asked for" | Google caps a text query at 60 results; ask for a bigger limit (more query variants run) or a wider city/region |
| nothing matched | relax the filters first: drop `--min-rating`, un-tick "only with phone", then try another city spelling |
| window opens bigger than the screen | it self-corrects now; if it persists, delete `~/.local/share/maplead/` and restart |
| nothing happens on double-click | your file manager may not allow executing it — run it from a terminal once, or use the menu entry |

Still stuck? Open an issue with the output of `maplead --selftest` and
`maplead --check-keys`.

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# colour plumbing
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

_FORCE = os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_NO_COLOR", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no")
FORCE_PLAIN = os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_ASCII", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no")
# lets you keep the colours when piping:  ./maplead.py | less -R
_FORCE_COLOR = os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_FORCE_COLOR", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no")


def _tty_ok() -> bool:
    if _FORCE:
        return False
    return sys.stdout.isatty() and os.environ.get("TERM", "") not in ("dumb", "")


COLOR = (_tty_ok() or _FORCE_COLOR) and not FORCE_PLAIN
PLAIN = not COLOR or FORCE_PLAIN

RESET = "\x1b[0m"
BOLD = "\x1b[1m"
DIM = "\x1b[2m"
ITALIC = "\x1b[3m"
UNDER = "\x1b[4m"

# bright foreground helpers
FG = {
    "black": 30, "red": 31, "green": 32, "yellow": 33,
    "blue": 34, "magenta": 35, "cyan": 36, "white": 37,
}
_BRIGHT = {k: v + 60 for k, v in FG.items()}


def c(text: str, color: str = "", bold: bool = False, dim: bool = False) -> str:
    """Colour a string (no-op when the terminal cannot show colour)."""
    if PLAIN or not text:
        return text
    prefix = ""
    if color in _BRIGHT:
        prefix += f"\x1b[{_BRIGHT[color]}m"
    elif color in FG:
        prefix += f"\x1b[{FG[color]}m"
    elif isinstance(color, int):
        prefix += f"\x1b[38;5;{color}m"
    if bold:
        prefix += BOLD
    if dim:
        prefix += DIM
    return f"{prefix}{text}{RESET}" if prefix else text


def c256(text: str, n: int, bold: bool = False) -> str:
    return c(text, int(n), bold=bold)


def gradient(text: str, start: int = 39, end: int = 207, bold: bool = True) -> str:
    """Paint each visible character with a smooth 256-colour ramp."""
    if PLAIN:
        return text
    out = []
    n = max(len(text) - 1, 1)
    step = 0
    for ch in text:
        if ch == " ":
            out.append(ch)
            continue
        out.append(c256(ch, round(start + (end - start) * step / n), bold=bold))
        step += 1
    return "".join(out)


def term_width(default: int = 96) -> int:
    try:
        return max(48, min(shutil.get_terminal_size((default, 24)).columns, 160))
    except Exception:
        return default

        pixels = []
        for glyph in glyphs:
            pixels.append("".join(fill if px == "#" else " " for px in glyph[row]))
        lines.append(" ".join(pixels))
    return lines

def banner(width: int | None = None, subtitle: str | None = None,
           status: str | None = None, compact: bool = False) -> str:
    """The full cool banner: logo, gradient wordmark, tagline, status bar."""
    width = width or min(term_width(), 110)
    logo = _PIN_ASCII if PLAIN else _PIN
    mark = wordmark()
    tagline = subtitle or "G O O G L E   M A P S   L E A D   E X T R A C T O R"

    lw = _logo_width()
    gap = 3
    total = lw + gap + max(len(r) for r in mark)
    left = max(1, (width - total) // 2)
    left = 0 if total > width else left

    lines: list[str] = []
    lines.append(c(hr(GLYPH["h"], width, "cyan")))
    lines.append("")

    # wordmark rows, gradient across the whole block
    for row in mark:
        lines.append(" " * left + gradient(row, start=84, end=201))
    lines.append(" " * left + c(f"v{VERSION}", "cyan", bold=True))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(" " * left + c(tagline, "cyan", dim=True))
    lines.append("")

    # logo + capability strip
    caps = _caps()
    cap_lines = [
        c("  " + a.ljust(16), "cyan") + c(b.rjust(2), "yellow", bold=True)
        for a, b in caps
    ]

    logo_rows = list(logo)
    for i in range(max(len(logo_rows), len(cap_lines))):
        art_ = logo_rows[i] if i < len(logo_rows) else " " * lw
        art_ = c(art_, "magenta", bold=True)
        side = cap_lines[i] if i < len(cap_lines) else ""
        lines.append(" " * left + art_ + "   " + side)

    lines.append("")
    if status is None:
        status = _status_line()
    if status:
        lines.append(" " * left + c(f"{GLYPH['dot']} {status}", "white", dim=True))
    if not compact:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(c(hr(GLYPH["h"], width, "cyan")))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def mini_banner() -> str:
    """One-liner used when the big banner is suppressed."""
    mark = wordmark("MAPLEAD")[1]
    return gradient(mark, 84, 201) + c(f"  v{VERSION}  ", "cyan")


def section(title: str, width: int | None = None) -> str:
    """A titled horizontal rule."""
    width = width or min(term_width(), 110)
    text = f" {title} "
    pad = max(0, width - len(text) - 4)
    return "\n" + c(GLYPH["tl"] + GLYPH["h"] + text + GLYPH["h"] * pad + GLYPH["tr"],
                    "cyan", bold=True)


def panel(title: str, rows: list[str], width: int | None = None, color: str = "cyan") -> str:
    width = width or min(term_width(), 110)
    inner = width - 4
    head = f" {title} ".upper()
    out = [c(GLYPH["tl"] + head + GLYPH["h"] * max(0, inner - len(head)) + GLYPH["tr"], color, bold=True)]
    for r in rows:
        plain_len = len(_strip_ansi(r))
        out.append(c(GLYPH["v"], color) + " " + r + " " * max(0, inner - plain_len - 1) + c(GLYPH["v"], color))
    out.append(c(GLYPH["bl"] + GLYPH["h"] * (inner + 1) + GLYPH["br"], color))
    return "\n".join(out)


_ANSI_RESET = "\x1b[0m"


def _strip_ansi(s: str) -> str:
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i] == "\x1b":
            j = i + 1
            if j < len(s) and s[j] == "[":
                j += 1
                while j < len(s) and not s[j].isalpha():
                    j += 1
                i = j + 1
                continue
        out.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def success_block(msg: str, detail: str = "") -> str:
    """Big block-font DONE stamp + a one-line summary."""
    stamp = block_text("DONE", fill=("#" if PLAIN else "█"))
    art_w = max(len(r) for r in stamp)
    body = [" ".join(stamp)]
    body.append(" " + msg)
    if detail:
        body.append(" " + detail)
    width = max(art_w, max(len(b) for b in body)) + 2
    lines = [c("╔" + "═" * (width + 2) + "╗", "green", bold=True)]
    for row in body:
        lines.append(c("║", "green", bold=True) + " " + row + " " * (width - len(row)) +
                     c("║", "green", bold=True))
    lines.append(c("╚" + "═" * (width + 2) + "╝", "green", bold=True))
    return "\n".join([c(line, "green", bold=True) if i == 0 else line
                      for i, line in enumerate(lines)])


def spinner(i: int) -> str:
    return GLYPH["spin"][i % len(GLYPH["spin"])]

def detect_provider(explicit: str | None, demo: bool, interactive: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    if demo:
        return "demo"
    if explicit:
        cls = PROVIDERS[explicit]
        if cls.is_configured():
            return explicit
        ui.warn(f"no API key found for {cls.label} ({', '.join(cls.env_keys)})")
        if demo or not interactive:
            return "demo"
        return ask_provider()
    found = [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()]
    if found:
        return found[0]
    return None


def ask_provider() -> str:
    items = list(PROVIDERS)
    choice = ui.ask_choice(
        "Which lead-scraper API should I use?",
        items,
        labeler=lambda n: f"{PROVIDERS[n].label}  ({PROVIDERS[n].name})",
        sublabeler=lambda n: (
            "✓ key detected: " + (PROVIDERS[n].api_key() or "")[:14] + "…"
            if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured() else
            f"needs {' or '.join(PROVIDERS[n].env_keys)}"
        ),
        default_index=ORDER.index("outscraper") if "outscraper" in ORDER else 0,
        extra=[("demo", "offline sample data, no key needed")],
    )
    return choice


def ask_country() -> CO.Country:
    table = {(c.name, c.dial): c for c in CO.COUNTRIES}
    items = list(table)
    ui.out()
    ui.hint(f"type any country name to filter · {len(CO.COUNTRIES)} countries available")
    while True:
        key = ui.ask_choice(
            "Which country do you want leads from?",
            items,
            labeler=lambda k: k[0],
            sublabeler=lambda k: f"{k[1]}   ·   {len(CO.BY_NAME[k[0].lower()].states)} regions"
            if CO.BY_NAME[k[0].lower()].states else f"{k[1]}",
            extra=[("other", "type a country name not in the list")],
            min_col=30, max_cols=3,

        if key == "other":

def ask_city(country: CO.Country, region: str) -> str:
    """
    City with ready-made options - never a blank box.

    * region chosen    -> the cities of that region are listed
    * "I don't know"    -> every catalogued city in the country, each tagged
                          with its region, so the list is browsable
    * region is a city -> it comes back as option 1 (Japan/Norway/Singapore
                          list cities where other countries list states)
    * anything else    -> one word away, type it
    """
    where = region or country.name
    hints = CI.candidates(country.iso, region)

    if not hints:
        ui.hint(f"no city list for {where} — just type the city name")
        return ui.ask_text(f"Which city in {where}?", required=True,
                           placeholder="e.g. Berlin")

    sub = {name: reg for name, reg in hints if reg}
    items = [name for name, _ in hints]
    region_is_city = bool(region) and CI.is_city(country.iso, region)
    region_filtered = bool(region) and bool(CI.match_region(country.iso, region))

    if region_is_city:
        items = [region] + [n for n in items if n != region]
        sub[region] = f"“{region}” is a city — keep it as the search centre"
    elif not region_filtered:
        ui.hint(f"no city list narrowed to {where} — showing {len(items)} cities "
                f"across {country.name} · type to filter")

    spread = len({sub[n] for n in items if n in sub}) > 1
    pick = ui.ask_choice(
        f"Which city in {where}?",
        items,
        labeler=lambda n: n,
        sublabeler=(lambda n: sub.get(n, "")) if (spread or region_is_city) else None,
        extra=[("__other__", "type a city that is not in the list")],
        min_col=32, max_cols=3,
    )
    if pick == "__other__":
        return ui.ask_text("City name", required=True, placeholder=items[0])
    return pick


def ask_business() -> tuple[str, List[str]]:
    """Return (display term, search term list)."""
    items = list(VT.VERTICALS)
    pick = ui.ask_choice(
        "What type of local business are you hunting leads for?",
        items,
        labeler=lambda v: f"{v.label}",
        sublabeler=lambda v: (
            (v.tips + "   ") if v.tips else ""
        ) + c("searches as ", "white", dim=True) + c(f'“{v.query}”', "white", dim=True)
        + (c(f'  also: {", ".join(v.synonyms[:3])}', "white", dim=True) if v.synonyms else ""),
        default_index=0,
        extra=[("__custom__", "type your own business type")],
        min_col=42, max_cols=2,
    )
    if pick != "__custom__":
        return pick.label, [pick.query] + list(pick.synonyms[:2])

    while True:
        text = ui.ask_text("Business type", required=True,
                           placeholder="e.g. solar panel installer")
        hits = VT.resolve(text)
        if not hits:
            if ui.ask_yesno(f"No catalog match for '{text}'. Use it as-is?", True):
                return text, [text]
            continue
        if len(hits) == 1:
            return hits[0].label, [hits[0].query] + list(hits[0].synonyms[:2])
        pick2 = ui.ask_choice("Did you mean", hits, labeler=lambda v: v.label,
                              sublabeler=lambda v: f'“{v.query}”')
        return pick2.label, [pick2.query] + list(pick2.synonyms[:2])


def ask_fields(provider_name: str) -> List[str]:

def run_wizard(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    # Fully-specified command lines skip every prompt (script-friendly).
    complete = all([args.country, args.city, args.business, args.fields,
                    args.limit, args.format])
    auto = args.yes or complete

    # ---- banner ---------------------------------------------------------
    if not args.no_banner:
        found = [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()]
        status = (f"api keys detected → {'  ·  '.join(PROVIDERS[n].label for n in found)}"
                  if found else "no api keys found · offline demo mode available")
        ui.out()
        ui.out(art.banner(status=status))

    # ---- 1/9 provider ---------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(1, STEP_TOTAL, "data provider")
    provider_name = detect_provider(args.provider, args.demo, not auto)
    if not provider_name:
        ui.warn("no API key found for any online provider.")
        ui.hint("add one in 10 seconds:   ./maplead.py --api")
        ui.hint("or set it by hand:      OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY=xxx  in .env / your shell")
        if auto:
            provider_name = "demo"
        else:
            if not ui.ask_yesno("Continue in offline demo mode instead?", True):
                return 2
            provider_name = "demo"
    provider = get_provider(provider_name)
    ui.info(f"{c(provider.label, 'yellow', bold=True)} · per-query cap "
            f"{provider.per_query_cap} results · {provider.homepage}")

    # ---- 2/9 country ----------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(2, STEP_TOTAL, "country")
    country: CO.Country
    if args.country:
        hits = CO.find(args.country)
        if not hits:
            ui.error(f"unknown country '{args.country}'")
            return 2
        country = hits[0]
    else:
        country = ask_country()
    ui.info(f"{c(country.name, 'white', bold=True)} {c(country.dial, 'cyan')} "

    if args.region is not None:

    elif auto:

    else:
        region = ask_region(country)
    ui.info(c(region or "(whole country)", "white", bold=True))

    # ---- 4/9 city --------------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(4, STEP_TOTAL, "city")
    if args.city:
        city = args.city
    elif auto:
        ui.error("--city is required in non-interactive mode")
        return 2
    else:
        city = ask_city(country, region)
    ui.info(c(city or f"(everywhere in {region or country.name})", "white", bold=True))

    # ---- 5/9 business type ----------------------------------------------
    ui.step(5, STEP_TOTAL, "business type")
    if args.business:
        hits = VT.resolve(args.business)
        if hits:
            v = hits[0]
            business_label, terms = v.label, [v.query] + list(v.synonyms[:2])
        else:
            business_label, terms = args.business, [args.business]
    elif auto:
        ui.error("--business is required in non-interactive mode")
        return 2
    else:
        business_label, terms = ask_business()
    ui.info(c(business_label, "white", bold=True) + c(f"   queries: {', '.join(terms)}", "white", dim=True))

    # ---- 6/9 fields ------------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(6, STEP_TOTAL, "fields to extract")
    if args.fields:
        chosen = FD.parse_selection(args.fields)
        if not chosen:
            ui.error(f"could not parse fields '{args.fields}'")
            return 2
    elif auto:
        chosen = [f for f in FD.RECOMMENDED if provider.supports(f)]
    else:
        chosen = ask_fields(provider.name)
    chosen = [f for f in chosen if provider.supports(f)]
    unsupported = [f for f in FD.parse_selection(args.fields)] if args.fields else []
    unsupported = [f for f in unsupported if f not in chosen]
    if unsupported:
        ui.warn("these fields are not available from this provider and were dropped: "
                + ", ".join(unsupported))
    grouped: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
    for f in chosen:
        grouped.setdefault(FD.group_of(f), []).append(f)
    for grp, keys in grouped.items():
        ui.info(f"{c(grp, 'cyan'):<22} {c('·'.join(keys), 'white')}")

    # ---- 7/9 volume + filters -------------------------------------------
    ui.step(7, STEP_TOTAL, "how many leads")
    limit = args.limit or (120 if not auto else 40)
    if not args.limit and not auto:
        limit = ui.ask_number("Target number of leads", 60, minimum=1, maximum=100_000)
    ui.info(f"{c(str(limit), 'yellow', bold=True)} unique leads")
    if not auto and not args.min_rating:
        raw = ui.ask_text("Minimum rating (0 = no filter, blank = skip)", allow_skip=True)
        if raw:
            try:
                args.min_rating = float(raw)
                ui.info(c(f"dropping anything rated below {args.min_rating} ★", "white"))
            except ValueError:
                ui.warn(f"'{raw}' is not a number - ignoring")
    if not auto:
        args.require_phone = args.require_phone or ui.ask_yesno(
            "Only keep leads that have a phone number?", False)
        args.require_website = args.require_website or ui.ask_yesno(
            "Only keep leads that have a website?", False)

    # ---- 8/9 format ------------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(8, STEP_TOTAL, "output format")
    fmt = args.format or (ask_format() if not auto else "csv")
    place = city or region or country.name
    outpath = args.out or exporters.suggest_path(fmt, f"{business_label}-{place}", args.outdir)
    ui.info(f"{c(exporters.LABEL[fmt], 'yellow', bold=True)} {c(exporters.DESC[fmt], 'white', dim=True)}")
    ui.info(f"file → {c(outpath, 'white', bold=True)}")

    # ---- summary ---------------------------------------------------------
    plan = engine.SearchPlan(
        provider=provider, city=city, region=region, country=country.name,
        country_code=country.iso, dial=country.dial, terms=terms, fields=chosen,
        limit=limit, language=args.language or country.lang,
        min_rating=args.min_rating, min_reviews=args.min_reviews,
        require_phone=args.require_phone, require_website=args.require_website,
        skip_closed=args.skip_closed, enrich=args.enrich,
    )
    ui.out()
    ui.out(ui.panel("search plan", [
        f"{c('provider', 'cyan')}  {provider.label} ({provider.name})",
        f"{c('location', 'cyan')}  {plan.location_label}",
        f"{c('business', 'cyan')}  {business_label}",
        f"{c('fields', 'cyan')}    {len(chosen)} selected",
        f"{c('target', 'cyan')}    {limit} leads",
        f"{c('output', 'cyan')}    {outpath}",
    ], color="magenta"))

    if not auto:
        if not ui.ask_yesno("Start scraping?", True):
            ui.info("cancelled.")
            return 0

    # ---- 9/9 run ---------------------------------------------------------
    ui.step(9, STEP_TOTAL, "scraping")
    return do_scrape(plan, fmt, outpath, chosen, args)


def do_scrape(plan: engine.SearchPlan, fmt: str, outpath: str,
              chosen: Sequence[str], args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    prog = ui.Progress("scraping", total=plan.limit)

    def note(msg: str) -> None:
        prog.update(msg)

    try:
        leads, report = engine.harvest(plan, progress=note)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        prog.stop()
        ui.out()
        ui.warn("interrupted.")
        return 130
    except ApiError as exc:
        prog.stop()
        ui.out()
        ui.error(str(exc))
        if plan.provider.name == "demo":
            return 1
        ui.hint("check the key, the provider plan/quota, and your network.")
        return 1
    prog.done(f"{len(leads)} leads in {report.elapsed:.1f}s")

    if not leads:
        ui.warn("no leads matched. try: a bigger limit, a different city spelling, "
                "or relax the filters.")
        for e in report.errors:
            ui.error(e)
        return 1

    # ---- preview ---------------------------------------------------------
    stats = engine.summarize(leads)
    ui.out()
    rows = []
    for lead in leads[:10]:
        rows.append([
            ui.trunc(lead.get("name", ""), 30),
            ui.trunc(lead.get("category", ""), 18),
            ui.trunc(lead.get("city", "") or lead.get("region", ""), 14),
            lead.get("phone", ""),
            lead.get("rating", "") or "",
            lead.get("reviews", "") or "",
            ui.trunc(lead.get("website", ""), 26),
        ])
    ui.out(ui.table(["business", "category", "city", "phone", "rating", "reviews", "website"],
                    rows, aligns=["left", "left", "left", "left", "right", "right", "left"]))
    if len(leads) > 10:
        ui.out()
        ui.hint(f"... and {len(leads) - 10} more")

    # ---- stats -----------------------------------------------------------
    filtered_total = sum(report.filtered.values())
    detail = ""
    if filtered_total:
        detail = c("   " + ", ".join(f"{k.replace('_', ' ')}: {v}"
                                     for k, v in report.filtered.items()), "white", dim=True)
    ui.out()
    ui.out(ui.panel("harvest report", [
        f"{c('raw results', 'cyan')}         {report.raw_count}",
        f"{c('duplicates removed', 'cyan')}   {report.duplicates}",
        f"{c('filtered out', 'cyan')}         {filtered_total}{detail}",
        f"{c('kept', 'cyan')}                 {c(str(len(leads)), 'green', bold=True)}",
        f"{c('with phone', 'cyan')}           {stats['with_phone']} "
        f"{c('(' + pct(stats['with_phone'], len(leads)) + ')', 'white', dim=True)}",
        f"{c('with website', 'cyan')}         {stats['with_website']} "
        f"{c('(' + pct(stats['with_website'], len(leads)) + ')', 'white', dim=True)}",
        f"{c('avg rating', 'cyan')}           {stats['avg_rating']} "
        f"{c('★', 'yellow')}   {c('total reviews: ' + str(stats['total_reviews']), 'white', dim=True)}",
        f"{c('queries run', 'cyan')}          {len(report.queries_run)}"
        f"{c(f' in {report.elapsed:.1f}s', 'white', dim=True)}",
    ], color="cyan"))
    if stats["top_cities"]:
        ui.out()
        ui.hint("top cities: " + "  ·  ".join(f"{n} ({k})" for n, k in stats["top_cities"][:4]))
    if len(leads) < plan.limit:
        ui.warn(f"got {len(leads)} of the {plan.limit} you asked for "
                f"— filters and duplicates removed the rest. "
                f"raise --limit or relax the filters.")
    if report.errors:
        for e in report.errors[:3]:
            ui.error(e)

    # ---- export ----------------------------------------------------------
    ui.out()
    include_extra = bool(getattr(args, "all_columns", False)) or \
        len(chosen) >= 0.8 * len(FD.FIELDS)
    columns = exporters.build_columns(chosen, leads, include_extra=include_extra)
    meta = {
        "query": (f"{plan.terms[0]} in {plan.location_label}"
                  if plan.location_label else plan.terms[0]),
        "location": plan.location_label,
        "business": ", ".join(plan.terms),
        "provider": f"{plan.provider.label} ({plan.provider.name})",
        "fields": len(columns),
        "generated_at": time_str(),
    }
    ui.info(f"writing {len(columns)} columns × {len(leads)} rows → {c(outpath, 'white', bold=True)}")
    if include_extra:
        ui.hint("every field the API returned is included (you selected almost everything)")
    try:
        info = exporters.write(fmt, outpath, leads, columns, meta)
    except OSError as exc:
        ui.error(f"could not write file: {exc}")
        return 1

    size = human_size(info["bytes"])
    ui.out()
    ui.out(art.success_block(
        f"{len(leads)} leads exported to {os.path.basename(outpath)}",
        f"{os.path.abspath(outpath)}  ·  {size}  ·  {info['columns']} columns  ·  .{fmt}"))

    if args.json:
        import json as _json
        ui.out(_json.dumps(leads, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
    return 0


def pct(part: int, whole: int) -> str:
    return f"{round(part * 100 / whole)}%" if whole else "0%"


def human_size(n: int) -> str:
    units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]
    value, i = float(n), 0
    while value >= 1024 and i < len(units) - 1:
        value /= 1024.0
        i += 1
    return f"{value:.0f} {units[i]}" if units[i] == "B" else f"{value:.1f} {units[i]}"


def time_str() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

def load_dotenv(path: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Load KEY=VALUE pairs from .env without clobbering the real environment.

    Looks next to the tool first, then in the user config dir, then in the
    current directory. Returns the file that was used (or would be written).
    """
    return paths.load_env(path)


def save_key(key: str, value: str, path: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Write KEY=VALUE into .env, preserving comments and other keys."""
    return paths.save_env_key(key, value, path or ENV_FILE)


def clear_key(key: str, path: str | None = None) -> bool:
    return paths.clear_env_key(key, path or ENV_FILE)

_ERROR_HINTS = (
    ("REQUEST_INVALID_API_KEY", "that key is not valid for this API"),
    ("API key not valid", "that key is not valid for this API"),
    ("API_KEY_INVALID", "that key is not valid for this API"),
    ("PERMISSION_DENIED", "key is valid but Places API (New) is probably not enabled "
                          "on the project - enable it + billing in Google Cloud Console"),
    ("Invalid API key", "that key is not valid for this API"),
    ("403", "the key was rejected - check the plan / quota on the provider's dashboard"),
    ("401", "authentication failed - double-check the key you pasted"),
    ("429", "rate limited right now - wait a minute and try again"),
    ("ENABLE", "the API is not enabled on your project yet"),
)


def explain_error(exc: Exception) -> str:
    msg = str(exc)
    for needle, hint in _ERROR_HINTS:
        if needle.lower() in msg.lower():
            return hint
    return ""


def check_key(provider_name: str, quiet: bool = False) -> bool:
    """Live-validate one provider's stored key."""
    provider = get_provider(provider_name)
    if provider_name != "demo" and not provider.is_configured():
        ui.error(f"{provider.label}: no key set")
        return False
    if not quiet:
        ui.info(f"testing {c(provider.label, 'yellow', bold=True)}…")
    try:
        ok, message = provider.validate()
    except ApiError as exc:
        ui.error(str(exc))
        hint = explain_error(exc)
        if hint:
            ui.hint(hint)
        return False
    except Exception as exc:  # network trouble, etc.
        ui.error(f"could not reach the API: {exc}")
        return False
    ui.ok(f"{provider.label}: {message}")
    return ok


def run_api_setup(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """The --api wizard: pick a provider, paste the key, verify, save."""
    ui.out()
    ui.out(art.banner(status="api key setup"))

    chosen = args.api_provider
    if not chosen:
        items = [n for n in PROVIDERS if n != "demo"]
        chosen = ui.ask_choice(
            "Which service is your API key for?",
            items,
            labeler=lambda n: f"{PROVIDERS[n].label}  ({n})",
            sublabeler=lambda n: (
                "✓ key already set — you'll replace it"
                if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()
                else f"paste it after: {', '.join(PROVIDERS[n].env_keys)}"
            ),
            extra=[("demo", "skip keys entirely, use offline sample data")],
        )
        if chosen == "demo":
            ui.out()
            ui.ok("no key needed - run the demo with:")
            ui.out(f"   {c('./maplead.py --demo', 'yellow', bold=True)}")
            return 0

    cls = PROVIDERS[chosen]
    ui.out()
    ui.out(ui.panel(f"set {cls.label}", [
        f"env var   {', '.join(cls.env_keys) if cls.env_keys else '(none - this provider needs no key)'}",
        f"get one   {cls.homepage}",
        f"saved to  {ENV_FILE if cls.env_keys else '(nothing to save)'}",
    ], color="cyan"))

    values: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for var in cls.env_keys:
        existing = os.environ.get(var, "").strip()
        raw = ui.ask_text(f"paste your {var}", default=existing if existing else "",
                          placeholder="paste the key, then press enter")
        raw = raw.strip().strip("'\"")
        if not raw:
            ui.error(f"{var} cannot be empty")
            return 2
        values[var] = raw

    # save first so validate() reads it from the environment
    if values:
        for var, val in values.items():
            save_key(var, val)
        ui.out()
        ui.ok(f"saved to {c(os.path.abspath(ENV_FILE), 'white', bold=True)} "
             f"{c('(chmod 600)', 'white', dim=True)}")
    else:
        ui.out()
        ui.info(f"{cls.label} needs no credentials - nothing to save.")

    valid = check_key(chosen)
    if valid:
        ui.out()
        ui.info("you are ready. next:")
        ui.out(f"   {c('./maplead.py', 'yellow', bold=True)}"
               f"   {c('→ interactive wizard', 'white', dim=True)}")
        if not args.yes and ui.ask_yesno("Start the lead wizard now?", True):
            args.provider = chosen
            ui.out()
            return run_wizard(args)
    else:
        ui.hint("the key is saved anyway — fix it and re-run:  ./maplead.py --api " + chosen)
    return 0 if valid else 1


def remove_keys(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    only = getattr(args, "remove_key", None)
    targets = [only] if only else list(PROVIDERS)
    hit_any = False
    for name in targets:
        cls = PROVIDERS[name]
        if name == "demo":
            continue
        for var in cls.env_keys:
            if clear_key(var):
                hit_any = True
                ui.ok(f"cleared {var}")
    if not hit_any:
        ui.info("no stored keys to remove")
    return 0


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    load_dotenv()
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)

    try:
        if args.gui:
            try:
                from .gui.app import main as gui_main
            except ImportError as exc:
                ui.error(f"the desktop app needs PySide6 ({exc}).")
                ui.hint("pip install PySide6-Essentials   -or-   use the terminal wizard.")
                return 3
            passthrough = ["--provider", args.provider] if args.provider else []
            return gui_main(passthrough)
        if args.api:
            return run_api_setup(args)
        if args.check_keys:
            ui.out()
            ui.out(art.banner(status="api key check", compact=True))
            names = [args.provider] if args.provider else [n for n in ORDER]
            results = [check_key(n) for n in names]
            ui.out()
            if not any(results):
                ui.warn("no working key found")
                ui.hint("set one with:  ./maplead.py --api")
            return 0 if any(results) else 1
        if args.remove_keys:
            return remove_keys(args)
        if args.list_providers:
            print_provider_status()
            return 0
        if args.list_fields:
            print_field_catalogue(args.provider)
            return 0
        return run_wizard(args)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        ui.out()
        ui.warn("aborted - nothing was changed.")
        return 130
    except Exception as exc:  # last-resort: never dump a raw traceback at users
        ui.out()
        ui.error(f"unexpected error: {exc}")
        if os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_DEBUG"):
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
        else:
            ui.hint("set MAPLEAD_DEBUG=1 to see the full traceback")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def norm(text: str) -> str:
    """Case/accent/punctuation-insensitive key ("São Paulo" == "sao paulo")."""
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", str(text or ""))
    t = "".join(ch for ch in t if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
    t = t.lower().replace("&", " and ")
    t = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", t)
    return " ".join(t.split())


def _unique(seq: Sequence[str]) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
    seen, out = set(), []
    for item in seq:
        k = norm(item)
        if k and k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            out.append(item)
    return tuple(out)


_TABLE: Dict[str, Dict[str, Tuple[str, ...]]] = {
    iso: {norm(region): _unique(cities) for region, cities in regions.items()}
    for iso, regions in _REGIONS.items()
}
_FALLBACK: Dict[str, Tuple[str, ...]] = {iso: _unique(cities) for iso, cities in _COUNTRY.items()}


def match_region(iso: str, region: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """Best (loosest) match for a region name inside a country's table."""
    key = norm(region)
    if not key:
        return None
    table = _TABLE.get(iso, {})
    if key in table:
        return key
    for candidate in table:                      # "new york" ~ "new york state"
        if candidate.startswith(key) or key.startswith(candidate):
            return candidate
    return None


def _pretty(iso: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Show a region the way countries.py spells it, when possible."""
    from . import countries as CO          # local import: countries has no deps
    country = CO.BY_ISO.get(iso)
    if country:
        for state in country.states:
            if norm(state) == key:
                return state
    return key.title()


def candidates(iso: str, region: str = "") -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    """
    Ready-made (city, region) pairs to offer.

    * known region   -> the cities of that region
    * unknown region -> every catalogued city in the country, tagged with its
                        region so the user can still orient themselves
                        (a city that belongs to two regions is listed once)
    """
    iso = (iso or "").lower()
    match = match_region(iso, region)
    if match:
        label = _pretty(iso, match)
        return [(city, label) for city in _TABLE[iso][match]]
    pairs: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    seen: set = set()
    for key, cities in _TABLE.get(iso, {}).items():
        label = _pretty(iso, key)
        for city in cities:
            k = norm(city)
            if k not in seen:
                seen.add(k)
                pairs.append((city, label))
    for city in _FALLBACK.get(iso, ()):
        if norm(city) not in seen:
            seen.add(norm(city))
            pairs.append((city, ""))
    return pairs


def region_of(iso: str, city: str) -> str:
    """Which region a city belongs to ("" when it is not catalogued)."""
    key = norm(city)
    for region, cities in _TABLE.get((iso or "").lower(), {}).items():
        if any(norm(c) == key for c in cities):
            return _pretty((iso or "").lower(), region)
    return ""


def is_city(iso: str, name: str) -> bool:
    """
    True when the "region" the user picked is really a city name.

    Plenty of entries in the region list are cities (Japan's states are cities,
    Norway's too, Singapore's are districts...) - catching them here is what lets
    the wizard offer "Tokyo" straight back as the city.
    """
    iso = (iso or "").lower()
    key = norm(name)
    if not key or match_region(iso, name):
        return False
    if region_of(iso, name):
        return True
    return any(norm(c) == key for c in _FALLBACK.get(iso, ()))


def count() -> int:
    """How many cities the wizard can offer."""
    total = sum(len(v) for v in _FALLBACK.values())
    for table in _TABLE.values():
        total += len(table)                       # regions are counted once
    return total

"""ISO country reference data + per-country region hints."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Country:
    name: str
    iso: str          # ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (lower-case)
    dial: str         # calling code
    lang: str         # default Places language code
    states: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default=())
    aliases: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default=())

    @property
    def google_gl(self) -> str:
        return self.iso.upper()

    @property
    def region_code(self) -> str:
        return self.iso.upper()

    def label(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.name}  ({self.dial})"

    def search(self) -> str:
        return (self.name + " " + self.iso + " " + " ".join(self.aliases)).lower()

def find(term: str) -> List[Country]:
    """Resolve a free-text country (name, iso code or alias)."""
    t = (term or "").strip().lower()

def supported_by(keys: Sequence[str], provider: str) -> List[str]:
    return [k for k in keys if k in BY_KEY and provider in BY_KEY[k].providers]


def unsupported_by(keys: Sequence[str], provider: str) -> List[str]:
    return [k for k in keys if k in BY_KEY and provider not in BY_KEY[k].providers]


def parse_selection(raw: str) -> List[str]:
    """Parse 'name,phone,rating' / 'all' / 'rec' / 'basic' / 'sales' / csv of keys."""
    t = (raw or "").strip().lower()
    if not t:
        return []
    if t in ("all", "*"):
        return list(EVERYTHING)
    for pkey, _, keys in PRESETS:
        if t == pkey:
            return list(keys)
    out: List[str] = []
    for chunk in t.replace(";", ",").split(","):
        chunk = chunk.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
        if not chunk:
            continue
        if chunk in BY_KEY:
            out.append(chunk)
            continue
        hits = [k for k in BY_KEY if chunk in k]
        out.extend(hits)
    seen, res = set(), []
    for k in out:
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            res.append(k)
    return res

def resolve(term: str) -> List[Vertical]:
    """Resolve free text to verticals (label / key / synonym substring)."""
    t = (term or "").strip().lower()
    if not t:
        return []
    if t in BY_KEY:
        return [BY_KEY[t]]

    return hits
