"""
MAPLEAD Desktop - application entry point.

    maplead-gui                 normal launch
    maplead-gui --selftest      headless smoke test (builds the UI, runs a demo search)

The AppImage launcher calls :func:`main`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
from typing import List, Optional, Sequence

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from .. import paths
from ..art import VERSION
from ..providers import PROVIDERS
from . import theme as theme_mod

DESKTOP_ID = "io.github.maplead.Desktop"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# argument parsing
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="maplead-gui",
        description=f"MAPLEAD {VERSION} desktop - interactive Google Maps lead extractor")
    p.add_argument("--provider", choices=list(PROVIDERS), help="pre-select a provider")
    p.add_argument("--country", help="pre-select a country (name or ISO code)")
    p.add_argument("--city", help="pre-select a city")
    p.add_argument("--business", help="pre-select a business type")
    p.add_argument("--theme", choices=("dark", "light"), help="force a theme")
    p.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true",
                   help="headless check: build the window, run a demo search, exit")
    p.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=f"MAPLEAD {VERSION}")
    return p


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# boot
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def preferred_theme() -> str:
    """Dark by default, light when the desktop asks for it."""
    if os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_LIGHT", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no"):
        return "light"
    if os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_DARK", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no"):
        return "dark"
    try:
        from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
        if QGuiApplication.styleHints().colorScheme() == Qt.Light:
            return "light"
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "dark"


def create_app(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None):
    """Boot QApplication and paint the first palette."""
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(list(sys.argv[:1]))
    app.setApplicationName("MAPLEAD")
    app.setApplicationDisplayName("MAPLEAD")
    app.setApplicationVersion(VERSION)
    app.setOrganizationName("maplead")
    app.setOrganizationDomain("maplead.local")
    app.setDesktopFileName(DESKTOP_ID)
    app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(True)

    from PySide6.QtGui import QIcon
    from . import icons
    app.setWindowIcon(QIcon(icons.pixmap("pin", theme_mod.DARK.accent, 64)))

    theme_mod.apply_theme(app, theme_mod.PALETTES[args.theme or preferred_theme()])
    return app, args


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
    paths.load_env()
    app, args = create_app(argv)

    from .main_window import MainWindow

    windows: List = []
    theme_name = args.theme or preferred_theme()
    window = MainWindow(theme_mod.PALETTES[theme_name])

    def swap(name: str) -> None:
        """Rebuild the window under a new palette (icons are palette-bound)."""
        geometry = window.saveGeometry()
        window._save_state()                 # so the new window comes back filled in
        theme_mod.apply_theme(app, theme_mod.PALETTES[name])
        fresh = MainWindow(theme_mod.PALETTES[name])
        fresh.restoreGeometry(geometry)
        fresh.theme_changed.connect(swap)
        fresh.show()
        windows.append(fresh)
        window.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DeleteOnClose, True)
        window.close()

    window.theme_changed.connect(swap)
    window.show()
    windows.append(window)

    _apply_cli_prefill(window, args)

    if args.selftest:
        return selftest(window)
    return app.exec()


def _apply_cli_prefill(window, args) -> None:
    """Honour the few flags a shell/desktop launcher may pass."""
    if args.provider:
        window.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == args.provider)
    if args.country:
        from ..data import countries as CO
        hits = CO.find(args.country)
        if hits:
            window.country_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda c: c is hits[0])
    if args.city:
        window.city_combo.setCurrentText(args.city)
    if args.business:
        window.business_combo.setCurrentText(args.business)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# headless self test  (used by the build script and by CI)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def selftest(window) -> int:
    """Build-check the window, then run one offline search end to end."""
    import tempfile

    from .worker import HarvestWorker

    print(f"[selftest] window: {window.windowTitle()}")
    print(f"[selftest] keys file   : {paths.user_env_file()}")
    print(f"[selftest] export dir  : {paths.default_export_dir()}")
    print(f"[selftest] theme       : {window.p.name}")
    print(f"[selftest] providers   : {', '.join(PROVIDERS)}")

    # -- fill the form like a user would -------------------------------- #
    window.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == "demo")
    window.country_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda c: c.iso == "de")
    window.region_combo.setCurrentText("Berlin")
    window.city_combo.setCurrentText("Berlin")
    window.business_combo.setCurrentText("Plumber")
    window.limit_spin.setValue(25)
    window.cb_phone.setChecked(True)
    idx = window.format_combo.findData("xlsx")
    if idx >= 0:
        window.format_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

    problems = window._problems()
    if problems:
        print("[selftest] FAILED - form validation: " + "; ".join(problems))
        return 1
    print(f"[selftest] plan       : {window.plan_label.text()}")

    spec = window.spec()
    spec.outpath = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="maplead-selftest-"),
                               "selftest-leads.xlsx")

    state = {"result": None, "error": None}
    worker = HarvestWorker(spec)
    worker.log.connect(lambda msg, level: print(f"[selftest]   {level:>5} | {msg}"))
    worker.finished.connect(lambda result: state.update(result=result))
    worker.failed.connect(lambda msg, hint: state.update(error=f"{msg} {hint}".strip()))

    worker.run()                     # synchronous: direct connections fire inline

    if state["error"]:
        print(f"[selftest] FAILED: {state['error']}")
        return 1
    result = state["result"]
    if result is None:
        print("[selftest] FAILED: the worker produced no result")
        return 1

    # -- the window must show exactly what the worker produced ---------- #
    window._on_finished(result)
    print(f"[selftest] leads      : {len(result.leads)}")
    print(f"[selftest] table rows : {window.model.rowCount()} x {window.model.columnCount()}")
    print(f"[selftest] exported   : {result.exported} -> {result.outpath}")
    print(f"[selftest] queries    : {len(result.report.queries_run)} "
          f"in {result.report.elapsed:.2f}s")
    print(f"[selftest] stats      : {result.stats['total']} leads, "
          f"{result.stats['with_phone']} phones, "
          f"{result.stats['with_website']} sites")

    ok = (len(result.leads) > 0
          and result.exported
          and os.path.exists(result.outpath)
          and window.model.rowCount() == len(result.leads))
    if not ok:
        print("[selftest] FAILED: inconsistent results")
        return 1

    return 0 if _selftest_widgets(window) else 1


def _selftest_widgets(window) -> bool:
    """Exercise the dialogs and list widgets headlessly."""
    from ..data import fields as FD
    from .keys import KeysDialog
    from .widgets import FieldPickerDialog, SearchCombo

    ok = True

    # --- searchable combo (country picker) -------------------------------- #
    combo: SearchCombo = window.country_combo
    before = combo.currentIndex()
    combo._buffer = "braz"
    combo._apply()
    filtered_label = combo.currentText()
    combo._buffer = ""
    combo._fill(combo.entries())
    combo.setCurrentIndex(before)
    print(f"[selftest] combo filter 'braz' -> {filtered_label!r}")
    ok &= "razil" in filtered_label

    # --- field picker: presets, filters, provider gating ------------------- #
    picker = FieldPickerDialog("google", list(FD.RECOMMENDED), window)
    rec = picker.selected()
    picker._preset("all")
    everything = picker.selected()
    picker._preset("none")
    picker._filter("mail")
    matching = [k for k, b in picker._boxes.items() if not b.isHidden()]
    picker._filter("")
    gated = [k for k, b in picker._boxes.items() if not b.isEnabled()]
    print(f"[selftest] field picker: rec={len(rec)} all={len(everything)} "
          f"none=0 'mail' matches={matching} gated-for-google={len(gated)}")
    ok &= len(rec) > 0 and len(everything) >= len(rec) and len(matching) >= 1
    ok &= "email" in gated          # google cannot return e-mail: must be locked
    picker.deleteLater()

    # --- keys dialog builds and reports ------------------------------------ #
    keys = KeysDialog(window.p, window)
    rows = len(keys.rows)
    keys.rows["outscraper"].verify_result(True, "selftest ok")
    keys.rows["google"].verify_result(False, "selftest failure")
    print(f"[selftest] keys dialog: {rows} providers, file {keys.env_path}")
    ok &= rows >= 5 and "ok" in keys.rows["outscraper"].message.text()
    keys.deleteLater()

    print("[selftest] OK" if ok else "[selftest] FAILED: widget checks")
    return bool(ok)


def run() -> None:
    sys.exit(main())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()

_CACHE: Dict[tuple, QIcon] = {}


def svg(name: str, color: str = "#e6edf7") -> bytes:
    template = PATHS.get(name, PATHS["info"]).format(color=color)
    return template.encode("utf-8")


def pixmap(name: str, color: str = "#e6edf7", size: int = 18) -> QPixmap:
    pm = QPixmap(QSize(size, size))
    pm.fill(Qt.transparent)
    renderer = QSvgRenderer(QByteArray(svg(name, color)))
    painter = QPainter(pm)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    renderer.render(painter)
    painter.end()
    return pm


def icon(name: str, color: str = "#e6edf7", size: int = 18) -> QIcon:
    """Cached themed icon."""
    key = (name, color, size)
    if key not in _CACHE:
        ico = QIcon()
        for scale in (1, 2):                      # crisp on hidpi
            ico.addPixmap(pixmap(name, color, size * scale))
        _CACHE[key] = ico
    return _CACHE[key]

Handy to try the app or demo it.")) self.status.setText("always ready") self.status.setObjectName("badgeOk") return self.fields: Dict[str, QLineEdit] = {} for var in self.cls.env_keys: row = QHBoxLayout() row.setSpacing(8) var_label = QLabel(var) var_label.setStyleSheet( f"font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; color: {palette.text_dim};") var_label.setMinimumWidth(150) var_label.setToolTip(f"Environment variable: {var}") row.addWidget(var_label) edit = QLineEdit() edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Password) edit.setPlaceholderText("paste the key") edit.setText(os.environ.get(var, "")) edit.textChanged.connect(self._dirty) self.fields[var] = edit row.addWidget(edit, 1) show = QPushButton() show.setIcon(icons.icon("eye", palette.text_dim, 15)) show.setProperty("flat", True) show.setToolTip("show / hide") show.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, e=edit, b=show: self._toggle_echo(e, b)) row.addWidget(show) lay.addLayout(row) # -- actions -------------------------------------------------------- # actions = QHBoxLayout() actions.setSpacing(8) self.save_btn = QPushButton("Save & verify") self.save_btn.setProperty("accent", True) self.save_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._save(verify=True)) actions.addWidget(self.save_btn) plain = QPushButton("Save only") plain.setProperty("flat", True) plain.clicked.connect(lambda: self._save(verify=False)) actions.addWidget(plain) clear = QPushButton("Remove") clear.setProperty("flat", True) clear.setProperty("danger", True) clear.setIcon(icons.icon("trash", palette.danger, 14)) clear.clicked.connect(self._clear) actions.addWidget(clear) actions.addStretch(1) lay.addLayout(actions) self.message = QLabel("") self.message.setWordWrap(True) self.message.setObjectName("hint") self.message.setVisible(False) lay.addWidget(self.message) self._refresh() # -- behaviour ----------------------------------------------------------- def _toggle_echo(self, edit: QLineEdit, button: QPushButton) -> None: hidden = edit.echoMode() == QLineEdit.Password edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.Normal if hidden else QLineEdit.Password) button.setIcon(icons.icon("eye" if hidden else "lock", self.palette_.text_dim, 15)) def _dirty(self) -> None: self._set_status("unsaved", "badgeWarn") def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "badge") -> None: self.status.setText(text) self.status.setObjectName(kind) def _refresh(self) -> None: if self.name == "demo": return if self.cls.is_configured(): self._set_status("key detected", "badgeOk") else: self._set_status("no key yet", "badgeWarn") def _save(self, verify: bool) -> None: values = {var: edit.text().strip().strip("'\"") for var, edit in self.fields.items()} missing = [var for var, val in values.items() if not val] if missing: self._say(f"Fill in {', '.join(missing)} (or use Remove to clear it).", self.palette_.warning) return for var, val in values.items(): paths.save_env_key(var, val, self.env_path) self._refresh() self.changed.emit() if verify: self._say("Saved. Verifying with a live request…", self.palette_.text_dim) else: self._say(f"Saved to {self.env_path} (chmod 600)", self.palette_.success) def _clear(self) -> None: for var in self.fields: paths.clear_env_key(var, self.env_path) self.fields[var].clear() self._refresh() self.changed.emit() self._say("Key removed from the config file.", self.palette_.text_dim) def _say(self, text: str, color: str) -> None: self.message.setText(f'{text}') self.message.setVisible(bool(text)) def verify_result(self, ok: bool, message: str) -> None: if ok: self._say(f"✓ {message}", self.palette_.success) self._set_status("working key", "badgeOk") else: self._say(f"✕ {message}", self.palette_.danger) self._set_status("check the key", "badgeWarn") class KeysDialog(QDialog): """The provider/key manager window.""" def __init__(self, palette: Palette, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None): super().__init__(parent) self.palette_ = palette self.env_path = paths.user_env_file() self.setWindowTitle("MAPLEAD — API keys") self.setMinimumSize(700, 560) self.resize(740, 760) self._threads: List[QThread] = [] root = QVBoxLayout(self) root.setContentsMargins(20, 18, 20, 16) root.setSpacing(12) intro, intro_lay = card() head = QHBoxLayout() title = QLabel("API keys") title.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: {palette.text};") head.addWidget(title) head.addStretch(1) intro_lay.addLayout(head) intro_lay.addWidget(hint( f"Keys are stored in {self.env_path} with mode 600 and are " f"never sent anywhere except the provider you pick. Real environment " f"variables always win over this file.")) root.addWidget(intro) area = QScrollArea() area.setWidgetResizable(True) area.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame) holder = QWidget() holder_lay = QVBoxLayout(holder) holder_lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 6, 0) holder_lay.setSpacing(10) self.rows: Dict[str, ProviderRow] = {} for name in _PROVIDER_ORDER: row = ProviderRow(name, palette, self.env_path, holder) row.changed.connect(self._on_changed) holder_lay.addWidget(row) self.rows[name] = row holder_lay.addStretch(1) holder_lay.setSizeConstraint(QVBoxLayout.SetMinimumSize) area.setWidget(holder) area.setWidgetResizable(True) area.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff) root.addWidget(area, 1) foot = QHBoxLayout() self.env_label = QLabel("") self.env_label.setObjectName("hint") self.env_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse) foot.addWidget(self.env_label, 1) self.check_all = QPushButton("Check all saved keys") self.check_all.setIcon(icons.icon("refresh", palette.text_dim, 15)) self.check_all.clicked.connect(lambda: self._check_all()) foot.addWidget(self.check_all) close = QPushButton("Done") close.setProperty("accent", True) close.clicked.connect(self.accept) foot.addWidget(close) root.addLayout(foot) self._on_changed() # -- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------- def _on_changed(self) -> None: configured = [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()] self.env_label.setText( f"{len(configured)} of {len(ORDER)} providers ready " f"({', '.join(PROVIDERS[n].label for n in configured) if configured else 'none'})" f" · {self.env_path}") def _check_all(self) -> None: targets = [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()] if not targets: self.rows["google"]._say("No keys saved yet - paste one above.", self.palette_.warning) return for name in targets: self.rows[name]._say("Checking…", self.palette_.text_dim) self._verify(name) def _verify(self, name: str) -> None: from .worker import ValidateWorker worker = ValidateWorker(name) thread = QThread(self) worker.moveToThread(thread) thread.started.connect(worker.run) worker.done.connect(self._on_verified) worker.done.connect(thread.quit) thread.finished.connect(worker.deleteLater) self._threads.append(thread) thread.start() def _on_verified(self, name: str, ok: bool, message: str) -> None: self.rows[name].verify_result(ok, message) def closeEvent(self, event) -> None: # noqa: N802 (Qt API) for thread in self._threads: if thread.isRunning(): thread.quit() thread.wait(2500) super().closeEvent(event)

"""
MAPLEAD Desktop - main window.

Left: the 9 wizard answers as a form.  Right: live stats, the leads table and
the activity log.  Everything the terminal wizard asks is on this one screen.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings, QSize, Qt, QThread, QTimer, QUrl, Signal, Slot
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QGuiApplication, QKeySequence
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (QCheckBox, QComboBox, QDialog, QDoubleSpinBox,
                               QFileDialog, QFrame, QGridLayout, QHBoxLayout,
                               QLabel, QLineEdit, QMainWindow, QMenu, QMessageBox,
                               QProgressBar, QPushButton, QScrollArea, QSizePolicy,
                               QSpinBox, QSplitter, QToolButton, QVBoxLayout,
                               QWidget)

from .. import exporters, paths

from ..data import cities as CI

from ..data import fields as FD

                      SearchCombo, StatCard, build_table, card, editable_combo,

FORMAT_HINTS = {
    "csv": "Universal · Excel, Sheets, CRM import",
    "xlsx": "Formatted workbook + meta sheet",
    "json": "Full fidelity, keeps types",
    "txt": "Human readable list",
    "tsv": "Tab separated, pastes into Sheets",

}


class MainWindow(QMainWindow):

    theme_changed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, palette: Palette):
        super().__init__()
        self.p = palette
        self.theme_name = palette.name
        self.setWindowTitle(f"MAPLEAD {VERSION} — Google Maps lead extractor")
        self.setMinimumSize(QSize(1080, 700))
        self.resize(1280, 820)

        self.model = LeadsModel(list(FD.RECOMMENDED), self)
        self.proxy = LeadsFilter(self)
        self.proxy.setSourceModel(self.model)

        self._thread: Optional[QThread] = None
        self._worker: Optional[HarvestWorker] = None
        self._fields: List[str] = [f for f in FD.RECOMMENDED]
        self._last_outpath: str = ""
        self._manual_path = False

        self._build()
        self._restore_state()
        self._refresh_provider_status()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._apply_provider_defaults)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ UI --
    def _build(self) -> None:
        root = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(root)
        outer = QVBoxLayout(root)
        outer.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer.setSpacing(0)

        outer.addWidget(self._build_topbar())

        split = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)  # noqa: E501 - form on the left, data on the right
        split.setChildrenCollapsible(False)
        split.setHandleWidth(10)
        split.addWidget(self._build_left())
        split.addWidget(self._build_right())
        split.setStretchFactor(0, 0)
        split.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        split.setSizes([392, 880])
        outer.addWidget(split, 1)

        # status bar
        bar = self.statusBar()
        self.status_left = QLabel("")
        self.status_right = QLabel("")
        bar.addWidget(self.status_left, 1)
        bar.addPermanentWidget(self.status_right)

        self._build_menu()

    # -- top bar -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_topbar(self) -> QWidget:
        bar = QFrame()
        bar.setObjectName("topbar")
        bar.setFixedHeight(64)
        lay = QHBoxLayout(bar)
        lay.setContentsMargins(18, 8, 14, 8)
        lay.setSpacing(12)

        logo = QLabel()
        logo.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("pin", self.p.accent, 26))
        logo.setFixedSize(30, 30)
        lay.addWidget(logo)

        brand = QVBoxLayout()
        brand.setSpacing(0)
        name = QLabel("MAPLEAD")
        name.setObjectName("brand")
        tag = QLabel("Google Maps lead extractor")
        tag.setObjectName("hint")
        brand.addWidget(name)
        brand.addWidget(tag)
        lay.addLayout(brand)
        lay.addSpacing(10)

        self.provider_badge = QLabel("")
        self.provider_badge.setObjectName("badge")
        lay.addWidget(self.provider_badge)
        lay.addStretch(1)

        self.progress = QProgressBar()
        self.progress.setFixedWidth(210)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        lay.addWidget(self.progress)

        keys_btn = QPushButton("  API keys")
        keys_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("key", self.p.text_dim, 15))
        keys_btn.clicked.connect(self.open_keys)
        lay.addWidget(keys_btn)

        theme_btn = QToolButton()
        theme_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("sun" if self.p.is_dark else "moon",
                                    self.p.text_dim, 17))
        theme_btn.setToolTip("Switch between dark and light")
        theme_btn.clicked.connect(self.toggle_theme)
        lay.addWidget(theme_btn)
        return bar

    # -- left: the wizard form ---------------------------------------------
    def _build_left(self) -> QWidget:
        """Form in a scroll area + a pinned run bar underneath."""
        container = QWidget()
        container.setMinimumWidth(376)
        container.setMaximumWidth(474)
        lay = QVBoxLayout(container)
        lay.setContentsMargins(14, 14, 10, 12)
        lay.setSpacing(10)

        area = QScrollArea()
        area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        area.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        area.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        panel = self._build_left_panel()
        panel.setMinimumWidth(348)
        area.setWidget(panel)
        lay.addWidget(area, 1)
        lay.addWidget(self._build_runbar())
        return container

    def _build_left_panel(self) -> QWidget:
        panel = QWidget()
        panel.setMinimumWidth(360)
        panel.setMaximumWidth(460)
        outer = QVBoxLayout(panel)
        outer.setContentsMargins(14, 14, 8, 14)
        outer.setSpacing(12)

        # ---- 1 provider -------------------------------------------------- #
        provider_card, pl = card("1 · data provider")
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.provider_combo = SearchCombo()
        self.provider_combo.setEntries(
            [(f"{PROVIDERS[n].label}", n) for n in ORDER] + [("Demo (offline sample)", "demo")])
        self.provider_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_provider_changed)
        row.addWidget(self.provider_combo, 1)
        manage = QPushButton()
        manage.setIcon(icons.icon("sliders", self.p.text_dim, 15))
        manage.setToolTip("Manage API keys")
        manage.clicked.connect(self.open_keys)
        row.addWidget(manage)
        pl.addLayout(row)
        self.provider_note = QLabel("")
        self.provider_note.setObjectName("hint")
        self.provider_note.setWordWrap(True)
        pl.addWidget(self.provider_note)
        outer.addWidget(provider_card)

        # ---- 2-4 location ------------------------------------------------- #
        loc_card, ll = card("2-4 · where")
        self.country_combo = SearchCombo()
        self.country_combo.setEntries([(f"{c.name}  ({c.dial})", c) for c in CO.COUNTRIES])
        self.country_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_country_changed)
        ll.addWidget(field_label("Country"))
        ll.addWidget(self.country_combo)

        self.region_combo = editable_combo()
        self.region_combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText("region / state (optional)")
        self.region_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(lambda _=None: self._refresh_city_list())
        self.region_combo.lineEdit().setToolTip(
            "Leave empty to search the whole country")
        ll.addWidget(field_label("Region / state"))
        ll.addWidget(self.region_combo)

        self.city_combo = editable_combo()
        self.city_combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText("city")
        ll.addWidget(field_label("City"))
        ll.addWidget(self.city_combo)
        outer.addWidget(loc_card)

        # ---- 5 business ---------------------------------------------------- #
        biz_card, bl = card("5 · what business")
        self.business_combo = editable_combo([v.label for v in VT.VERTICALS])
        self.business_combo.setEditable(True)
        self.business_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self._on_business_changed)
        self.business_combo.lineEdit().setPlaceholderText("type anything, e.g. solar installer")
        bl.addWidget(self.business_combo)
        self.business_note = QLabel("")
        self.business_note.setObjectName("hint")
        self.business_note.setWordWrap(True)
        bl.addWidget(self.business_note)
        outer.addWidget(biz_card)

        # ---- 6 fields ------------------------------------------------------ #
        fields_card, fl = card("6 · fields")
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.fields_btn = QPushButton("Choose fields…")
        self.fields_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("list", self.p.text_dim, 15))
        self.fields_btn.clicked.connect(self.choose_fields)
        row.addWidget(self.fields_btn, 1)
        self.fields_count = QLabel("")
        self.fields_count.setObjectName("badge")
        row.addWidget(self.fields_count)
        fl.addLayout(row)
        self.fields_note = QLabel("")
        self.fields_note.setObjectName("hint")
        self.fields_note.setWordWrap(True)
        fl.addWidget(self.fields_note)
        outer.addWidget(fields_card)

        # ---- 7 volume + filters --------------------------------------------- #
        vol_card, vl = card("7 · how many + filters")
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.limit_spin = QSpinBox()
        self.limit_spin.setRange(1, 100_000)
        self.limit_spin.setValue(60)
        self.limit_spin.setSingleStep(10)
        self.limit_spin.setSuffix(" leads")
        row.addWidget(self.limit_spin, 1)
        self.limit_spin.setToolTip("Target number of leads to collect")
        vl.addLayout(row)

        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.setSpacing(6)
        self.min_rating = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.min_rating.setRange(0.0, 5.0)
        self.min_rating.setSingleStep(0.1)
        self.min_rating.setSpecialValueText("no filter")
        self.min_reviews = QSpinBox()
        self.min_reviews.setRange(0, 100_000)
        self.min_reviews.setSpecialValueText("no filter")
        grid.addWidget(field_label("Min rating"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.min_rating, 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(field_label("Min reviews"), 0, 1)
        grid.addWidget(self.min_reviews, 1, 1)
        vl.addLayout(grid)

        self.cb_phone = QCheckBox("Only leads with a phone")
        self.cb_site = QCheckBox("Only leads with a website")
        self.cb_closed = QCheckBox("Skip permanently closed")
        self.cb_enrich = QCheckBox("Enrich contacts (Outscraper, extra credits)")
        for box in (self.cb_phone, self.cb_site, self.cb_closed, self.cb_enrich):
            box.toggled.connect(self._sync_run_button)
            vl.addWidget(box)
        outer.addWidget(vol_card)

        # ---- 8 output ------------------------------------------------------- #
        out_card, ol = card("8 · export")
        self.format_combo = QComboBox()
        for fmt, label, desc in exporters.FORMATS:
            self.format_combo.addItem(f"{label}  ·  .{fmt}", fmt)
            idx = self.format_combo.count() - 1
            self.format_combo.setItemData(idx, desc, Qt.ToolTipRole)
        self.format_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._on_format_changed)
        ol.addWidget(self.format_combo)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(6)
        self.out_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.out_edit.setReadOnly(True)
        row.addWidget(self.out_edit, 1)
        browse = QPushButton()
        browse.setIcon(icons.icon("folder", self.p.text_dim, 15))
        browse.setToolTip("Choose the output file")
        browse.clicked.connect(self.choose_output)
        row.addWidget(browse)
        ol.addLayout(row)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(6)
        folder = QPushButton("Open folder")
        folder.setIcon(icons.icon("open", self.p.text_dim, 14))
        folder.clicked.connect(lambda: open_in_desktop(
            os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.out_edit.text())) or "."))
        row.addWidget(folder)
        reveal = QPushButton("Reveal last export")
        reveal.setIcon(icons.icon("file", self.p.text_dim, 14))
        reveal.clicked.connect(self.reveal_last)
        row.addWidget(reveal)
        row.addStretch(1)
        ol.addLayout(row)
        outer.addWidget(out_card)
        outer.addStretch(1)
        outer.setSizeConstraint(QVBoxLayout.SetMinimumSize)
        return panel

    def _build_runbar(self) -> QWidget:
        """Primary action, always visible (never scrolls out of reach)."""
        bar = QWidget()
        bar.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        lay = QVBoxLayout(bar)
        lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        lay.setSpacing(6)

        self.plan_label = QLabel("")
        self.plan_label.setObjectName("hint")
        self.plan_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.plan_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.plan_label.setMinimumHeight(30)
        lay.addWidget(self.plan_label)

        self.run_btn = QPushButton("  Run search")

    # -- right: results ------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_right(self) -> QWidget:
        panel = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(panel)
        lay.setContentsMargins(6, 14, 14, 14)
        lay.setSpacing(12)

        # stats
        stats_row = QHBoxLayout()
        stats_row.setSpacing(10)
        self.stat_leads = StatCard("leads", "–", "", self.p)
        self.stat_phone = StatCard("with phone", "–", "", self.p)
        self.stat_site = StatCard("with website", "–", "", self.p)
        self.stat_rating = StatCard("avg rating", "–", "", self.p)
        self.stat_reviews = StatCard("reviews", "–", "", self.p)
        self.stat_time = StatCard("elapsed", "–", "", self.p)
        for card_widget in (self.stat_leads, self.stat_phone, self.stat_site,

        title = QLabel("RESULTS")

        head.addWidget(self.result_count)
        head.addStretch(1)

        self.filter_edit.textChanged.connect(self.proxy.setNeedle)

        copy_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", self.p.text_dim, 14))

        rl.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        log_card.setMaximumHeight(210)
        lay.addWidget(log_card)

        self.log.write("Ready. Pick a provider, a city and a business type, then Run.", "info")
        return panel

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ behaviour --
    def _apply_provider_defaults(self) -> None:
        configured = [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()]
        if configured:
            self.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == configured[0])
        else:
            # nothing configured yet: open on Demo so the app works out of the box
            self.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == "demo")
            self.log.write("No API keys found yet - Demo mode is ready to use "
                           "(synthetic leads). Add a real key in API keys…", "warn")
        self._on_provider_changed()
        if not self.city_combo.currentText().strip():
            self.city_combo.setCurrentText("Berlin")
        self._on_business_changed()      # the first text is set before signals hook
        self._update_plan_label()

    def _refresh_provider_status(self) -> None:
        ready = [PROVIDERS[n].label for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()]
        if ready:
            self.provider_badge.setText("keys: " + ", ".join(ready))
            self.provider_badge.setObjectName("badgeOk")
        else:
            self.provider_badge.setText("no API keys — demo mode available")
            self.provider_badge.setObjectName("badgeWarn")
        self.provider_badge.style().unpolish(self.provider_badge)
        self.provider_badge.style().polish(self.provider_badge)

    def _on_provider_changed(self) -> None:
        name = self.provider_combo.value() or "demo"
        cls = PROVIDERS[name]
        if name == "demo":
            self.provider_note.setText(
                "Offline synthetic data — no key, no network. Try the whole app instantly.")
        else:
            key = cls.api_key() or ""
            masked = f"{key[:6]}…{key[-4:]}" if len(key) > 12 else ("key detected" if key else "")
            state = "key detected: " + masked if key else \
                f"no key — set {' or '.join(cls.env_keys)} in API keys"
            self.provider_note.setText(f"{state}  ·  up to {cls.per_query_cap} results "
                                       f"per query  ·  {cls.homepage}")
        self._sync_fields_availability()
        self._update_plan_label()
        self._sync_run_button()

    def _on_country_changed(self) -> None:
        country = self.country_combo.value()
        if not country:
            return
        states = list(country.states)
        self.region_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.region_combo.clear()
        self.region_combo.setEditable(True)
        self.region_combo.addItem("")
        self.region_combo.addItems(states)
        self.region_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.region_combo.setPlaceholderText(
            f"{len(states)} regions listed — or type one" if states
            else "region / state (optional)")
        self.region_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._refresh_city_list()

    def _refresh_city_list(self) -> None:
        country = self.country_combo.value()
        if not country:
            return
        region = self.region_combo.currentText().strip()
        names = [name for name, _ in CI.candidates(country.iso, region)]
        self.city_combo.clear()
        self.city_combo.setEditable(True)
        self.city_combo.addItems(names)
        self.city_combo.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.NoInsert)
        if names:
            self.city_combo.setCurrentText(names[0])
        self.city_combo.setPlaceholderText(
            f"{len(names)} catalogued cities — or type one" if names else "city name")
        self._update_plan_label()

    def _on_business_changed(self) -> None:
        text = self.business_combo.currentText().strip()
        hits = VT.resolve(text) if text else []
        if hits:
            v = hits[0]
            note = f'Searches as “{v.query}”'
            if v.synonyms:
                note += f'  ·  also {", ".join(v.synonyms[:2])}'
            if text.lower() not in (v.label.lower(), v.query.lower()):
                note += f'  ·  matched “{v.label}”'
            self.business_note.setText(note)
        else:
            self.business_note.setText("Free-text search term." if text else "")
        self._update_plan_label()

    def _sync_fields_availability(self) -> None:
        provider = self.provider_combo.value() or "demo"
        self._fields = [f for f in self._fields if _supports(provider, f)]
        if not self._fields:
            self._fields = [f for f in FD.RECOMMENDED if _supports(provider, f)]
        self._refresh_fields_label()

    def _refresh_fields_label(self) -> None:
        provider = self.provider_combo.value() or "demo"
        usable = [f for f in self._fields if _supports(provider, f)]
        self.fields_count.setText(f"{len(usable)} selected")
        groups: Dict[str, int] = {}
        for f in usable:
            groups[FD.group_of(f)] = groups.get(FD.group_of(f), 0) + 1
        self.fields_note.setText("  ".join(f"{g} ×{n}" for g, n in groups.items()))

    def choose_fields(self) -> None:
        provider = self.provider_combo.value() or "demo"
        dlg = FieldPickerDialog(provider, self._fields, self)
        if dlg.exec() == QDialog.Accepted:
            self._fields = dlg.selected() or list(FD.BASIC)
            self._refresh_fields_label()
            self._update_plan_label()

    def _on_format_changed(self) -> None:
        # keep the auto-suggested name in step with the chosen extension
        if not self._manual_path:
            self.out_edit.setText(self._suggest_path())
        self._update_plan_label()

    def _set_result_count(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.result_count.setText(text)
        self.result_count.setVisible(bool(text))

    def choose_output(self) -> None:
        fmt = self.format_combo.currentData() or "csv"
        current = self.out_edit.text() or self._suggest_path()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current) or paths.default_export_dir()
        paths.ensure_dir(start_dir)
        chosen, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self, "Save leads to", current,
            f"{exporters.LABEL[fmt]} (*.{fmt});;All files (*)")
        if chosen:
            if not chosen.lower().endswith(f".{fmt}"):
                chosen += f".{fmt}"
            self.out_edit.setText(chosen)
            self._manual_path = True

    def _suggest_path(self) -> str:
        fmt = self.format_combo.currentData() or "csv"
        country = self.country_combo.value()
        place = (self.city_combo.currentText().strip()
                 or self.region_combo.currentText().strip()
                 or (country.name if country else "leads"))
        business = self.business_combo.currentText().strip() or "leads"
        return exporters.suggest_path(fmt, f"{business}-{place}", paths.default_export_dir())

    def reveal_last(self) -> None:
        if self._last_outpath and os.path.exists(self._last_outpath):
            open_in_desktop(self._last_outpath)
        else:
            open_in_desktop(paths.default_export_dir())

    # -- plan preview --------------------------------------------------------
    def spec(self) -> SearchSpec:
        country = self.country_combo.value()
        text = self.business_combo.currentText().strip()
        hits = VT.resolve(text)
        vertical = hits[0] if hits else None
        provider = self.provider_combo.value() or "demo"
        fmt = self.format_combo.currentData() or "csv"
        region = self.region_combo.currentText().strip()
        city = self.city_combo.currentText().strip()
        if region and region.lower() == city.lower():
            region = ""            # "Berlin, Berlin, Germany" reads badly
        return SearchSpec(
            provider_name=provider,
            country=country,
            region=region,
            city=city,
            business_label=vertical.label if vertical else text,
            terms=[vertical.query] + list(vertical.synonyms[:2]) if vertical else [text],
            fields=list(self._fields),
            limit=self.limit_spin.value(),
            language=(country.lang if country else "en"),
            min_rating=self.min_rating.value() or None,
            min_reviews=self.min_reviews.value() or None,
            require_phone=self.cb_phone.isChecked(),
            require_website=self.cb_site.isChecked(),
            skip_closed=self.cb_closed.isChecked(),
            enrich=self.cb_enrich.isChecked(),
            fmt=fmt,
            outpath=self.out_edit.text() or self._suggest_path(),
            outdir=paths.default_export_dir(),
        )

    def _update_plan_label(self) -> None:
        spec = self.spec()
        problems = self._problems()
        if problems:
            # say *why* Run is greyed out instead of leaving the user guessing
            self.plan_label.setText("⚠  " + problems[0])
            self.plan_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {self.p.warning};")
        else:
            where = ", ".join(p for p in (spec.city, spec.region,
                                          spec.country.name if spec.country else "") if p)
            queries = ", ".join(spec.terms[:2])
            self.plan_label.setText(
                f"{len(spec.fields)} fields → .{spec.fmt}  ·  “{queries}”"
                f" in {where or '…'}")
            self.plan_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._sync_run_button()

    def _problems(self) -> List[str]:
        issues: List[str] = []
        spec = self.spec()
        if not spec.city and not spec.region:
            issues.append("pick a city (or a region)")
        if not spec.terms or not spec.terms[0].strip():
            issues.append("choose a business type")
        if not spec.fields:
            issues.append("select at least one field")
        if spec.provider_name != "demo" and not PROVIDERS[spec.provider_name].is_configured():
            issues.append(f"{PROVIDERS[spec.provider_name].label} has no API key — "
                          "open API keys, or switch to Demo")
        return issues

    def _sync_run_button(self) -> None:
        running = self._thread is not None and self._thread.isRunning()
        if running:
            self.run_btn.setText("  Stop")
            self.run_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", self.p.text_dim, 15))
            self.run_btn.setProperty("accent", False)
        else:
            self.run_btn.setText("  Run search")
            self.run_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", self.p.accent_text, 15))
            self.run_btn.setProperty("accent", True)
        self.run_btn.setEnabled(not self._problems() or running)
        self.run_btn.style().unpolish(self.run_btn)
        self.run_btn.style().polish(self.run_btn)

    # -- run / stop ----------------------------------------------------------
    def toggle_run(self) -> None:
        if self._thread is not None and self._thread.isRunning():
            self.stop()
            return
        issues = self._problems()
        if issues:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Almost there",
                                "Before running:\n\n• " + "\n• ".join(issues))
            return
        self.start()

    def start(self) -> None:
        spec = self.spec()
        self.out_edit.setText(spec.outpath)
        self.model.clear()
        self.proxy.setNeedle("")
        self.filter_edit.clear()
        self._set_result_count("running…")
        self.log.clear()
        self._set_stats(leads=0, phone=0, site=0, rating=None, reviews=0, elapsed=0.0)
        self.table.set_empty_text("Scraping…\n\nresults appear here as they come in")
        self.progress.setVisible(True)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self._set_form_enabled(False)

        self._worker = HarvestWorker(spec)
        self._thread = QThread(self)
        self._worker.moveToThread(self._thread)
        self._thread.started.connect(self._worker.run)
        self._worker.log.connect(self._on_log)
        self._worker.progress.connect(self.on_progress)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self._worker.failed.connect(self._on_failed)
        self._worker.finished.connect(self._thread.quit)
        self._worker.failed.connect(self._thread.quit)
        self._thread.finished.connect(self._worker.deleteLater)
        self._thread.finished.connect(self._cleanup_thread)
        self._sync_run_button()
        self._thread.start()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.stop()
        self.log.write("Stop requested — finishing the current query…", "warn")
        self.run_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _cleanup_thread(self) -> None:
        self._thread = None
        self._worker = None
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_form_enabled(True)
        self._sync_run_button()

    def _set_form_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        for widget in (self.provider_combo, self.country_combo, self.region_combo,
                       self.city_combo, self.business_combo, self.fields_btn,
                       self.limit_spin, self.min_rating, self.min_reviews,
                       self.cb_phone, self.cb_site, self.cb_closed, self.cb_enrich,
                       self.format_combo):
            widget.setEnabled(enabled)
        # keys + theme stay usable mid-run: neither can corrupt a harvest
        self.act_run.setEnabled(not enabled and not self._problems())

    # -- worker callbacks ----------------------------------------------------
    @Slot(str, str)
    def _on_log(self, message: str, level: str) -> None:
        self.log.write(message, level)

    def on_progress(self, value: float) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(int(value * 100))

    def _on_finished(self, result: RunResult) -> None:
        self.model.set_leads(result.leads, result.columns)
        if not result.leads:
            self.table.set_empty_text(
                "No leads matched those filters.\n\n"
                "Try a bigger limit, a different city spelling,\n"
                "or relax the rating / phone filters.")
        stats = result.stats
        self._set_stats(leads=stats["total"],
                        phone=stats["with_phone"],
                        site=stats["with_website"],
                        rating=stats["avg_rating"],
                        reviews=stats["total_reviews"],
                        elapsed=result.report.elapsed)
        report = result.report
        self.log.write(
            f"Kept {stats['total']} of {report.raw_count} raw results "
            f"({report.duplicates} duplicates, "
            f"{sum(report.filtered.values()) if report.filtered else 0} filtered) "
            f"in {report.elapsed:.1f}s", "ok")
        for err in report.errors[:3]:
            self.log.write(err, "error")
        self._set_result_count(
            f"{stats['total']} rows · {self.proxy.rowCount()} shown"
            if stats["total"] else "no leads matched — try a bigger limit or a "
                                  "different city spelling")
        if result.exported:
            self._last_outpath = result.outpath
            self.status_right.setText(result.outpath)
        if stats["total"] and result.report.raw_count:
            self.status_left.setText(
                f"{stats['total']} leads · {self.proxy.rowCount()} shown after filter")
        if result.error:
            self.log.write(result.error, "error")

    def _on_failed(self, message: str, hint_text: str) -> None:
        self.log.write(message, "error")
        if hint_text:
            self.log.write(hint_text, "warn")
        box = QMessageBox(self)
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Warning)
        box.setWindowTitle("Search failed")
        box.setText(message)
        if hint_text:
            box.setInformativeText(hint_text)
        if self.provider_combo.value() == "demo":
            pass
        else:
            box.setStandardButtons(QMessageBox.Ok)
            open_keys = box.addButton("Open API keys", QMessageBox.ActionRole)
            box.exec()
            if box.clickedButton() is open_keys:
                self.open_keys()
            return
        box.exec()

    def _set_stats(self, leads: int, phone: int, site: int,
                   rating: Optional[float], reviews: int, elapsed: float) -> None:
        def pct(part: int) -> str:
            return f"{round(part * 100 / leads)}%" if leads else "—"

        self.stat_leads.set(str(leads), f"target {self.limit_spin.value()}")
        self.stat_phone.set(pct(phone), f"{phone} with a number")
        self.stat_site.set(pct(site), f"{site} with a URL")
        self.stat_rating.set(f"{rating:.2f} ★" if rating else "–",
                             "average" if rating else "")
        self.stat_reviews.set(f"{reviews:,}", "total reviews")
        self.stat_time.set(f"{elapsed:.1f}s" if elapsed else "–",
                           f"{len(self.model.leads)} rows")
        for widget in (self.stat_leads, self.stat_phone, self.stat_site,
                       self.stat_rating):
            widget.set_accent(self.p.text)
        if leads:
            self.stat_leads.set_accent(self.p.success)

    # -- table actions -------------------------------------------------------
    def _fit_columns(self) -> None:
        """Give every column a width that fits its own content."""
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for col, width in self.model.column_widths().items():
            header.resizeSection(col, width)

    def copy_selection(self) -> None:
        rows = {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()} \
            if self.table.selectionModel() else set()
        if not rows:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Copy", "Select one or more rows first.")
            return
        self._copy_rows(sorted(rows), tab=False)

    def _copy_rows(self, rows: List[int], tab: bool) -> None:
        sep = "\t" if tab else ", "
        lines: List[str] = []
        if tab:
            headers = [str(self.model.headerData(c, Qt.Horizontal))
                       for c in range(self.model.columnCount())]
            lines.append(sep.join(headers))
        for row in rows:
            lead = self.model.leads[row]
            cells = []
            for key in self.model.columns:
                text = self.model._display(key, lead.get(key)).replace("\n", " ")
                if not tab and "," in text:       # keep CSV-ish quotes out of the way
                    text = f'"{text}"'
                cells.append(text)
            lines.append(sep.join(cells))
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText("\n".join(lines))
        self.log.write(f"Copied {len(rows)} row(s) to the clipboard.", "ok")

    def table_menu(self, pos) -> None:
        index = self.table.indexAt(pos)
        if not index.isValid():
            return
        lead = self.model.leads[self.proxy.mapToSource(index).row()]
        key = self.model.columns[self.proxy.mapToSource(index).column()]
        menu = QMenu(self)
        act_copy = menu.addAction(icons.icon("copy", self.p.text_dim, 14), "Copy cell")
        act_row = menu.addAction("Copy row")
        act_tsv = menu.addAction("Copy row as TSV")
        act_sheet = menu.addAction("Copy selection as spreadsheet text")
        menu.addSeparator()
        act_maps = menu.addAction(icons.icon("pin", self.p.text_dim, 14), "Open in Google Maps")
        act_site = menu.addAction(icons.icon("external", self.p.text_dim, 14), "Open website")
        act_phone = menu.addAction(icons.icon("search", self.p.text_dim, 14), "Search phone online")
        chosen = menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(pos))
        if chosen is None:
            return
        if chosen == act_copy:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(self.model._display(key, lead.get(key)))
            self.log.write("Cell copied.", "ok")
        elif chosen in (act_row, act_tsv):
            row = self.proxy.mapToSource(index).row()
            self._copy_rows([row], tab=chosen is act_tsv)
        elif chosen == act_sheet:
            rows = sorted({i.row() for i in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()})
            self._copy_rows([self.proxy.mapToSource(self.proxy.index(r, 0)).row()
                             for r in rows], tab=True)
        elif chosen == act_maps:
            open_in_desktop(lead.get("maps_url") or lead.get("website") or "")
        elif chosen == act_site:
            if lead.get("website"):
                open_in_desktop(str(lead["website"]))
        elif chosen == act_phone:
            phone = str(lead.get("phone") or "").strip()
            if phone:
                QGuiApplication.openUrl(QUrl(f"https://www.google.com/search?q={phone}"))

    def open_row(self, index) -> None:
        source = self.proxy.mapToSource(index)
        if not source.isValid():
            return
        lead = self.model.leads[source.row()]
        target = lead.get("maps_url") or lead.get("website")
        if target:
            open_in_desktop(str(target))

    # -- persistence ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _fit_to_screen(self) -> None:
        """A window remembered from a bigger screen must not hide Run/Stop."""
        screen = QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
        if screen is None:
            return
        avail = screen.availableGeometry()
        width = min(self.width(), avail.width())
        height = min(self.height(), avail.height())
        if (width, height) != (self.width(), self.height()):
            self.resize(max(self.minimumWidth(), width),
                        max(self.minimumHeight(), height))
        if not avail.intersects(self.frameGeometry()):
            self.move(avail.topLeft())

    def _settings(self) -> QSettings:
        return QSettings("maplead", "maplead-desktop")

    def _restore_state(self) -> None:
        s = self._settings()
        geo = s.value("geometry")
        if geo:
            self.restoreGeometry(geo)
        self._fit_to_screen()
        theme = s.value("theme", self.p.name)
        self.theme_name = theme if theme in ("dark", "light") else self.p.name
        state = s.value("form")
        if state:
            try:
                data = json.loads(state)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                data = {}
            self._load_form(data if isinstance(data, dict) else {})
        self._fields = [f for f in self._fields if f in FD.BY_KEY] or list(FD.RECOMMENDED)
        self._refresh_fields_label()
        self._update_plan_label()

    def _load_form(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        try:
            if data.get("provider") in PROVIDERS:
                self.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == data["provider"])
            if data.get("country"):
                iso = data["country"]
                self.country_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda c: c.iso == iso)
            if "region" in data:
                self.region_combo.setCurrentText(data["region"] or "")
            if data.get("city"):
                self.city_combo.setCurrentText(data["city"])
            if data.get("business"):
                self.business_combo.setCurrentText(data["business"])
            if data.get("fields"):
                self._fields = [f for f in data["fields"] if f in FD.BY_KEY]
            self.limit_spin.setValue(int(data.get("limit", 60)))
            self.min_rating.setValue(float(data.get("min_rating", 0) or 0))
            self.min_reviews.setValue(int(data.get("min_reviews", 0) or 0))
            self.cb_phone.setChecked(bool(data.get("require_phone")))
            self.cb_site.setChecked(bool(data.get("require_website")))
            self.cb_closed.setChecked(bool(data.get("skip_closed")))
            self.cb_enrich.setChecked(bool(data.get("enrich")))
            fmt = data.get("format", "csv")
            idx = self.format_combo.findData(fmt)
            if idx >= 0:
                self.format_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)
            # a hand-picked path is sticky; an auto-suggested one gets a fresh
            # timestamp every launch
            if data.get("outpath"):
                self.out_edit.setText(data["outpath"])
                self._manual_path = True
            else:
                self.out_edit.setText(self._suggest_path())
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self.out_edit.setText(self._suggest_path())

    def _save_state(self) -> None:
        spec = self.spec()
        s = self._settings()
        s.setValue("geometry", self.saveGeometry())
        s.setValue("theme", self.theme_name)
        s.setValue("form", json.dumps({
            "provider": spec.provider_name,
            "country": spec.country.iso if spec.country else "",
            "region": spec.region,
            "city": spec.city,
            "business": spec.business_label,
            "fields": self._fields,
            "limit": spec.limit,
            "min_rating": self.min_rating.value(),
            "min_reviews": self.min_reviews.value(),
            "require_phone": spec.require_phone,
            "require_website": spec.require_website,
            "skip_closed": spec.skip_closed,
            "enrich": spec.enrich,
            "format": spec.fmt,
            "outpath": self.out_edit.text() if self._manual_path else "",
        }))
        s.sync()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (Qt API)
        if self._thread is not None and self._thread.isRunning():
            if self._worker is not None:
                self._worker.stop()
            self._thread.quit()
            self._thread.wait(4000)
        self._save_state()
        super().closeEvent(event)

class SearchCombo(QComboBox):
    """
    Read-only combo you narrow down by typing (the terminal CLI lists in
    columns; on screen a filtered popup is the equivalent).

    Type to filter, Backspace to widen the search, Enter/Esc to finish.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._entries: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
        self._buffer = ""
        self.setModel(QStandardItemModel(self))
        self.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.NoInsert)
        self.view().setUniformItemSizes(True)

    # -- data ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def setEntries(self, entries: Sequence[Tuple[str, Any]]) -> None:
        self._entries = list(entries)
        self._buffer = ""
        self._fill(self._entries)
        if self._entries:
            self.setCurrentIndex(0)

    def _fill(self, entries: Sequence[Tuple[str, Any]]) -> None:
        model = QStandardItemModel(self)
        for label, _ in entries:
            item = QStandardItem(label)
            item.setEditable(False)
            model.appendRow(item)
        self.setModel(model)

    def entries(self) -> List[Tuple[str, Any]]:
        return list(self._entries)

    def value(self) -> Any:
        if self.currentIndex() < 0 or self.currentIndex() >= len(self._entries):
            return None
        return self._entries[self.currentIndex()][1]

    def setValueByPredicate(self, predicate: Callable[[Any], bool]) -> bool:
        for i, (_, payload) in enumerate(self._entries):
            if predicate(payload):
                self.setCurrentIndex(i)
                return True
        return False

    # -- keyboard filtering --------------------------------------------------
    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (Qt API)
        key = event.key()
        if key in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter):
            self.hidePopup()
            return
        if key == Qt.Key_Escape:
            self._buffer = ""
            self._fill(self._entries)
            self.hidePopup()
            return
        text = event.text()
        if key == Qt.Key_Backspace:
            self._buffer = self._buffer[:-1]
            self._apply()
            return
        if key == Qt.Key_Space and not text.strip():
            return
        if text and text.isprintable() and not event.modifiers():
            self._buffer += text
            self._apply()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _apply(self) -> None:
        needle = self._buffer.strip().lower()
        if not needle:
            self._fill(self._entries)
            return
        hits = [(label, payload) for label, payload in self._entries
                if needle in label.lower()]
        if not hits:                      # fall back to the whole list
            self._fill(self._entries)
            return
        self._fill(hits)
        self.setCurrentIndex(0)
        if not self.view().isVisible():
            self.showPopup()


def editable_combo(items: Sequence[str] = (), parent: Optional[QWidget] = None) -> QComboBox:
    """Editable combo + fuzzy completer, so free text is always allowed."""
    combo = QComboBox(parent)
    combo.setEditable(True)
    combo.setInsertPolicy(QComboBox.NoInsert)
    combo.addItems(list(items))
    completer = combo.completer()
    completer.setCaseSensitivity(Qt.CaseInsensitive)
    completer.setFilterMode(Qt.MatchContains)
    completer.setCompletionMode(QCompleter.PopupCompletion)
    line = combo.lineEdit()
    if line is not None:
        line.setPlaceholderText("type anything")
    return combo

def _needs_label(meta: FD.Field, provider: str) -> str:
    """Why a field is greyed out: the first service that could return it."""
    if meta.enriched and "outscraper" in meta.providers:
        return "Outscraper"

class FieldPickerDialog(QDialog):
    """Grouped, searchable multi-select over the whole field catalogue."""

    def __init__(self, provider: str, selected: Sequence[str],
                 parent: Optional[QWidget] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.provider = provider
        self.setWindowTitle("Fields to extract")
        self.setMinimumSize(620, 560)
        self._boxes: Dict[str, QCheckBox] = {}
        self._initial = list(selected)

        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(18, 18, 18, 16)
        root.setSpacing(10)

        head = QHBoxLayout()
        head.setSpacing(8)
        self.search = QLineEdit()
        self.search.setObjectName("searchBox")
        self.search.setPlaceholderText("filter fields…")
        self.search.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        head.addWidget(self.search, 1)
        for key, label in (("rec", "Recommended"), ("basic", "Basic"),
                           ("sales", "Sales-ready"), ("all", "All"), ("none", "None")):
            btn = QPushButton(label)
            btn.setProperty("flat", True)
            btn.clicked.connect(lambda _=False, k=key: self._preset(k))
            head.addWidget(btn)
        root.addLayout(head)

        area = QScrollArea()
        area.setWidgetResizable(True)
        area.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        area.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        holder = QWidget()
        self._grid = QVBoxLayout(holder)
        self._grid.setContentsMargins(2, 2, 6, 2)
        self._grid.setSpacing(4)
        self._grids: Dict[str, Tuple[QWidget, QGridLayout]] = {}
        for group in FD.GROUPS:
            keys = [f.key for f in FD.FIELDS if f.group == group]
            head_lbl = field_label(group)
            self._grid.addWidget(head_lbl)
            body = QWidget()
            gl = QGridLayout(body)
            gl.setContentsMargins(6, 2, 0, 6)
            gl.setSpacing(2)
            for i, key in enumerate(keys):
                meta = FD.BY_KEY[key]
                usable = provider in meta.providers
                box = QCheckBox(f"{meta.label}")
                box.setProperty("key", key)
                box.setChecked(key in selected)
                box.setEnabled(usable)
                if not usable:
                    box.setText(f"{meta.label}  ·  {_needs_label(meta, provider)}")
                    box.setToolTip(
                        f"{PROVIDER_NAMES.get(provider, provider)} cannot return this field. "
                        f"Available from: {meta.provider_note}")
                else:
                    tip = meta.note or f"{meta.key} · {meta.kind}"
                    if meta.enriched:
                        tip = f"{tip}  ·  needs Outscraper enrichment (extra credits)"
                    box.setToolTip(tip)
                box.toggled.connect(self._on_toggle)
                gl.addWidget(box, i // 2, i % 2)
                self._boxes[key] = box
            self._grid.addWidget(body)
            self._grids[group] = (body, gl)
        self._grid.addStretch(1)
        self._grid.setSizeConstraint(QVBoxLayout.SetMinimumSize)
        area.setWidget(holder)
        root.addWidget(area, 1)

        self.counter = QLabel("")
        self.counter.setObjectName("hint")
        root.addWidget(self.counter)

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.Ok | QDialogButtonBox.Cancel)
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.Ok).setText("Use these fields")
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.Ok).setProperty("accent", True)
        buttons.accepted.connect(self.accept)
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)
        root.addWidget(buttons)

        self.search.textChanged.connect(self._filter)
        self._sync()

    # -- helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _filter(self, text: str) -> None:
        needle = text.strip().lower()
        for key, box in self._boxes.items():
            meta = FD.BY_KEY[key]
            match = not needle or needle in meta.label.lower() or needle in key \
                or needle in meta.group.lower()
            box.setVisible(match)
            if needle:
                body, _ = self._grids[meta.group]
                body.setVisible(any(
                    not self._boxes[k].isHidden()
                    for k in (f.key for f in FD.FIELDS if f.group == meta.group)))

    def _preset(self, key: str) -> None:
        table = {name: keys for name, _, keys in FD.PRESETS}
        wanted: List[str] = [] if key == "none" else list(table.get(key, ()))
        for k, box in self._boxes.items():
            if box.isEnabled():
                box.setChecked(k in wanted)
        self._sync()

    def _on_toggle(self) -> None:
        self._sync()

    def _sync(self) -> None:
        chosen = self.selected()
        avail = sum(1 for b in self._boxes.values() if b.isEnabled())
        self.counter.setText(f"{len(chosen)} of {avail} fields selected "
                             f"(columns in the exported file)")

    # -- api -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def selected(self) -> List[str]:
        """Checked fields, in catalogue order."""
        return [f.key for f in FD.FIELDS if self._boxes.get(f.key)
                and self._boxes[f.key].isChecked()]

    def selected_initial(self) -> List[str]:
        return list(self._initial)

class LeadsModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    """Table model over a list of lead dicts; columns follow the field keys."""

    def __init__(self, columns: Sequence[str], parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.columns = list(columns)
        self.leads: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    # -- Qt ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()) -> int:
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.leads)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()) -> int:
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.columns)

    def data(self, index: QModelIndex, role=Qt.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        lead = self.leads[index.row()]
        key = self.columns[index.column()]
        value = lead.get(key)

        if role == Qt.DisplayRole:
            return self._display(key, value)
        if role == Qt.ToolTipRole:
            text = self._display(key, value)
            extra = {
                "maps_url": "Double-click to open in Google Maps",
                "website": "Double-click to open the website",
            }.get(key)
            if not text and value is not None:
                text = str(value)
            return f"{text}{chr(10) + extra if extra else ''}" if text else None
        if role == Qt.TextAlignmentRole:
            if key in _NUMERIC and isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                return int(Qt.AlignRight | Qt.AlignVCenter)
            return int(Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter)
        if role == Qt.UserRole:
            return value
        return None

    def headerData(self, section: int, orientation, role=Qt.DisplayRole):
        if role != Qt.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if orientation == Qt.Horizontal:
            return header_label(self.columns[section])
        return section + 1

    # -- api -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_leads(self, leads: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], columns: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.leads = list(leads)
        if columns is not None:
            self.columns = list(columns)
        self.endResetModel()
        self.widths_changed.emit()

    def column_widths(self) -> Dict[int, int]:
        """Size columns to their content, within sane bounds."""
        widths: Dict[int, int] = {}
        for col, key in enumerate(self.columns):
            longest = 0
            for lead in self.leads[:200]:
                longest = max(longest, len(self._display(key, lead.get(key))))
            header = len(header_label(key))
            target = max(longest, header) + 22
            widths[col] = max(_MIN_WIDTH.get(key, 80), min(target, 320))
        return widths

    widths_changed = Signal()

    def clear(self) -> None:
        self.set_leads([], self.columns)

    @staticmethod
    def _display(key: str, value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if key == "rating":
            try:
                stars = "★" * int(float(value))
                return f"{stars} {value}"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return str(value)
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            return "yes" if value else "no"
        if isinstance(value, float):
            return f"{value:g}"
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            return ", ".join(str(v) for v in value)[:120]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            import json
            return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)[:120]
        return str(value)


class LeadsFilter(QSortFilterProxyModel):
    """Free-text filter across every visible column."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._needle = ""
        self.setFilterCaseSensitivity(Qt.CaseInsensitive)

    def setNeedle(self, needle: str) -> None:  # noqa: N802 (Qt style)
        self._needle = needle.strip().lower()
        self.invalidateFilter()

    def filterAcceptsRow(self, row: int, parent: QModelIndex) -> bool:  # noqa: N802
        if not self._needle:
            return True
        model = self.sourceModel()
        for col in range(model.columnCount(parent)):
            value = model.data(model.index(row, col, parent), Qt.DisplayRole)
            if value and self._needle in str(value).lower():
                return True
        return False

        self.empty_text.setVisible(empty and self.isVisibleTo(self.parentWidget()))

        self.empty_text.setText(text)
        self._sync_placeholder()

def open_in_desktop(path_or_url: str) -> bool:
    """Hand a URL or file to the desktop's default handler."""
    import subprocess
    import sys
    try:
        if sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
            subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", path_or_url],
                             stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        elif sys.platform == "darwin":
            subprocess.Popen(["open", path_or_url])
        else:  # pragma: no cover - windows fallback
            os_startfile(path_or_url)
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def os_startfile(path: str) -> None:  # pragma: no cover
    import os
    os.startfile(path)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

@dataclass
class RunResult:
    leads: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    report: engine.HarvestReport
    stats: Dict[str, Any]
    columns: List[str]
    outpath: str
    fmt: str
    exported: bool = False
    error: str = ""
    error_hint: str = ""


def build_plan(spec: SearchSpec) -> engine.SearchPlan:
    """Turn the GUI inputs into the same SearchPlan the CLI builds."""
    provider: Provider = get_provider(spec.provider_name)
    country = spec.country or CO.find("United States")[0]
    fields = [f for f in spec.fields if provider.supports(f)]
    return engine.SearchPlan(
        provider=provider,
        city=spec.city,
        region=spec.region,
        country=country.name,
        country_code=country.iso,
        dial=country.dial,
        terms=list(spec.terms) or [spec.business_label or "business"],
        fields=fields,
        limit=max(1, spec.limit),
        language=spec.language or country.lang,
        min_rating=spec.min_rating,
        min_reviews=spec.min_reviews,
        require_phone=spec.require_phone,
        require_website=spec.require_website,
        skip_closed=spec.skip_closed,
        enrich=spec.enrich,
    )


_ERROR_HINTS = (
    ("REQUEST_INVALID_API_KEY", "That key is not valid for this API."),
    ("API key not valid", "That key is not valid for this API."),
    ("API_KEY_INVALID", "That key is not valid for this API."),
    ("Invalid API key", "That key is not valid for this API."),
    ("PERMISSION_DENIED", "Key is valid, but Places API (New) is probably not enabled "
                          "on the project - enable it and billing in Google Cloud Console."),
    ("403", "The key was rejected - check the plan / quota on the provider dashboard."),
    ("401", "Authentication failed - double-check the key you pasted."),
    ("429", "Rate limited right now - wait a minute and try again."),
    ("ENABLE", "The API is not enabled on your project yet."),
)


def explain(exc: Exception) -> str:
    msg = str(exc).lower()
    for needle, hint in _ERROR_HINTS:
        if needle.lower() in msg:
            return hint
    return ""


class HarvestWorker(QObject):
    """Runs engine.harvest + export off the GUI thread."""

    log = Signal(str, str)          # message, level
    progress = Signal(float)        # 0..1
    finished = Signal(object)        # RunResult
    failed = Signal(str, str)        # message, hint

    def __init__(self, spec: SearchSpec, parent: Optional[QObject] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.spec = spec
        self._stop = False
        self._queries = 1
        self._value = 0.0

    def stop(self) -> None:
        self._stop = True

    # -- slot ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def run(self) -> None:
        spec = self.spec
        try:
            plan = build_plan(spec)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.failed.emit(f"Could not build the search: {exc}", "")
            return

        self._queries = max(1, len(plan.queries()))
        self.log.emit(f"Plan: {plan.label}", "query")
        self.log.emit(f"Provider {plan.provider.label} · up to "
                      f"{plan.provider.per_query_cap} results per query", "info")

        try:
            leads, report = engine.harvest(
                plan,
                progress=self._on_progress,
                should_stop=lambda: self._stop,
            )
        except ApiError as exc:
            self.failed.emit(str(exc), explain(exc))
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            detail = traceback.format_exc(limit=3) if _debug() else ""
            self.failed.emit(f"Unexpected error: {exc}", detail)
            return

        if self._stop:
            self.log.emit("Stopped by user.", "warn")

        stats = engine.summarize(leads)
        include_extra = len(spec.fields) >= 0.8 * len(FD.FIELDS)
        columns = exporters.build_columns(plan.fields, leads, include_extra=include_extra)
        meta = {
            "query": f"{plan.terms[0]} in {plan.location_label}" if plan.location_label
                     else plan.terms[0],
            "location": plan.location_label,
            "business": ", ".join(plan.terms),
            "provider": f"{plan.provider.label} ({plan.provider.name})",
            "fields": len(columns),
            "generated_at": _now(),
        }
        result = RunResult(leads=leads, report=report, stats=stats,
                           columns=columns, outpath=spec.outpath, fmt=spec.fmt)

        if leads and spec.outpath:
            try:
                paths.ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(spec.outpath)) or ".")
                info = exporters.write(spec.fmt, spec.outpath, leads, columns, meta)
                result.exported = True
                self.log.emit(f"Wrote {info['rows']} rows × {info['columns']} columns "
                              f"→ {spec.outpath}", "ok")
            except OSError as exc:
                result.error = f"Could not write {spec.outpath}: {exc}"
                self.log.emit(result.error, "error")
        self.finished.emit(result)
        self.progress.emit(1.0)

    # -- progress ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_progress(self, message: str) -> None:
        level = "error" if message.startswith(("query failed", "stopped")) else "query"
        self.log.emit(message, level)
        if message.startswith("query "):
            try:
                done = int(message.split()[1].split("/")[0]) - 1
            except (IndexError, ValueError):
                done = 0
            self._value = min(0.95, (done + 0.5) / self._queries)
        self.progress.emit(self._value)


class ValidateWorker(QObject):
    """Live key check for one provider (blocking, off the GUI thread)."""

    done = Signal(str, bool, str)   # provider, ok, message

    def __init__(self, provider_name: str, parent: Optional[QObject] = None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.provider_name = provider_name

    def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            provider = get_provider(self.provider_name)
            ok, message = provider.validate()
        except ApiError as exc:
            self.done.emit(self.provider_name, False, f"{exc} — {explain(exc)}")
            return
        except Exception as exc:
            self.done.emit(self.provider_name, False, f"Could not reach the API: {exc}")
            return
        self.done.emit(self.provider_name, ok, message)


def _debug() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("MAPLEAD_DEBUG", "") not in ("", "0", "false", "no")


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

Lead providers: pluggable Google-Maps scraper APIs.

    google      official Google Places API (New)      -> GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
    outscraper  outscraper.com (richest field set)    -> OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY
    serpapi     serpapi.com google_maps engine        -> SERPAPI_API_KEY
    dataforseo  dataforseo.com business_data maps     -> DATAFORSEO_LOGIN/PASSWORD
    demo        offline generator, no key needed      -> --demo

Every provider returns the same normalised Lead dicts so the CLI/exporters
stay provider-agnostic.
"""
