@dataclass
class SearchRequest:
    query: str                 # full text query, e.g. "plumber in Berlin, Germany"
    location: Dict[str, str]   # city / region / country / country_code
    limit: int = 60
    fields: Sequence[str] = ()

@dataclass
class SearchResult:
    leads: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    query: str
    exhausted: bool = False    # provider says there is nothing more
    raw_total: int = 0
    error: Optional[str] = None


Lead = Dict[str, Any]


def _blank() -> Lead:
    return {
        "name": "", "category": "", "subcategory": "", "place_id": "",
        "maps_url": "", "status": "", "business_type": "",
        "address": "", "street": "", "city": "", "region": "",
        "postal_code": "", "country": "", "country_code": "",
        "latitude": None, "longitude": None, "distance": None,
        "phone": "", "website": "", "email": "", "whatsapp": "",
        "facebook": "", "instagram": "", "linkedin": "",
        "rating": None, "reviews": None, "price_level": "",
        "hours": "", "open_now": None, "is_chain": None, "chain_name": "",
        "logo_url": "", "photos_count": None, "year_established": None,
        "employees": None,
    }


def _clean(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.strip()
    return value


def _dig(obj: Any, *path: str, default: Any = "") -> Any:
    cur = obj
    for key in path:
        if not isinstance(cur, dict) or key not in cur:
            return default
        cur = cur[key]
    return default if cur is None else cur


def maps_link(place_id: str, lat: Any = None, lon: Any = None) -> str:
    if place_id:
        return f"https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query={place_id}&query_place_id={place_id}"
    if lat is not None and lon is not None:
        return f"https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query={lat},{lon}"
    return ""

class Provider:
    name = "base"
    label = "Base provider"
    env_keys: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    homepage = ""
    docs = ""
    #: hard ceiling of results the API returns per text query
    per_query_cap = 60

    def __init__(self, **config: Any):
        self.config = config
        self.limiter = RateLimiter(self.config.get("rate", 5.0))

    # -- key detection --------------------------------------------------- #
    @classmethod
    def api_key(cls) -> Optional[str]:
        for var in cls.env_keys:
            val = os.environ.get(var, "").strip()
            if val:
                return val
        return None

    @classmethod
    def is_configured(cls) -> bool:
        return bool(cls.api_key())

    # -- api ------------------------------------------------------------- #
    def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResult:  # pragma: no cover
        raise NotImplementedError

    def validate(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        """Cheap live round-trip to confirm the key works. Raises ApiError if not."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def supports(self, field_key: str) -> bool:
        from .data import fields as F
        meta = F.BY_KEY.get(field_key)
        return bool(meta and self.name in meta.providers)

    def describe(self) -> str:
        key = self.api_key()
        masked = (key[:6] + "…" + key[-4:]) if key and len(key) > 12 else ("set" if key else "missing")
        return f"{self.label:<14} key: {masked}"

_GOOGLE_FIELD_MAP = {
    "name": "displayName",
    "category": "primaryTypeDisplayName",
    "subcategory": "types",
    "place_id": "id",
    "status": "businessStatus",
    "business_type": "businessType",
    "address": "formattedAddress",
    "street": "shortFormattedAddress",
    "latitude": "location",
    "longitude": "location",
    "phone": "nationalPhoneNumber",
    "website": "websiteUri",
    "rating": "rating",
    "reviews": "userRatingCount",
    "price_level": "priceLevel",
    "hours": "regularOpeningHours",
    "open_now": "currentOpeningHours",
    "photos_count": "photos",
}

_GOOGLE_TOP_LEVEL = {"id", "displayName", "formattedAddress", "shortFormattedAddress",
                      "nationalPhoneNumber", "websiteUri", "rating", "userRatingCount",
                      "priceLevel", "businessStatus", "businessType", "location",
                      "regularOpeningHours", "currentOpeningHours", "photos"}

_GOOGLE_PRICE = {0: "Free", 1: "$", 2: "$$", 3: "$$$", 4: "$$$$"}


class GooglePlacesProvider(Provider):
    name = "google"
    label = "Google Places"
    env_keys = ("GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY", "GOOGLE_API_KEY")
    homepage = "https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service"
    per_query_cap = 60

    def _mask(self, fields: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        parts: List[str] = []
        for f in fields:
            mapped = _GOOGLE_FIELD_MAP.get(f)
            if not mapped:
                continue
            if mapped in _GOOGLE_TOP_LEVEL:
                parts.append(mapped)
            else:
                parts.append(f"{mapped}.name" if mapped == "types" else mapped)
        base = ["id", "displayName", "formattedAddress", "location"]
        return ",".join(dict.fromkeys(base + parts))

    def validate(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            return False, "GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is empty"
        resp = post_json(
            "https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places:searchText",
            body={"textQuery": "cafe in New York", "pageSize": 1, "languageCode": "en"},
            headers={"X-Goog-Api-Key": key,
                     "X-Goog-FieldMask": "places.id,places.displayName,places.formattedAddress"},
            provider=self.name, retries=1, timeout=30,
        )
        n = len(resp.get("places", []) or [])
        return True, f"Places API (New) reachable - test query returned {n} place(s)"

    def _place(self, raw: Dict[str, Any], req: SearchRequest) -> Lead:
        lead = _blank()
        lat = _dig(raw, "location", "latitude")
        lon = _dig(raw, "location", "longitude")
        lead.update({
            "name": _clean(_dig(raw, "displayName", "text")),
            "place_id": raw.get("id", ""),
            "maps_url": maps_link(raw.get("id", ""), lat, lon),
            "category": _clean(_dig(raw, "primaryTypeDisplayName", "text")),
            "business_type": _clean(raw.get("businessType", "")),
            "status": _clean(raw.get("businessStatus", "")),
            "address": _clean(raw.get("formattedAddress", "")),
            "street": _clean(raw.get("shortFormattedAddress", "")),
            "latitude": lat,
            "longitude": lon,
            "phone": _clean(raw.get("nationalPhoneNumber", "")),
            "website": _clean(raw.get("websiteUri", "")),
            "rating": raw.get("rating"),
            "reviews": raw.get("userRatingCount"),
            "price_level": _GOOGLE_PRICE.get(raw.get("priceLevel"), ""),
            "photos_count": len(raw.get("photos", []) or []) or None,
        })
        types = raw.get("types") or []
        lead["subcategory"] = ", ".join(types[:4])
        hours = raw.get("regularOpeningHours") or {}
        if hours.get("weekdayDescriptions"):
            lead["hours"] = " | ".join(hours["weekdayDescriptions"])
        cur = raw.get("currentOpeningHours") or {}
        if "openNow" in cur:
            lead["open_now"] = cur["openNow"]
        loc = req.location
        lead.update({"country": loc.get("country", ""), "country_code": loc.get("country_code", ""),
                     "city": loc.get("city", ""), "region": loc.get("region", "")})
        return lead

    def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResult:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            raise ApiError("GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is not set", provider=self.name)
        url = "https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places:searchText"
        headers = {"X-Goog-Api-Key": key, "X-Goog-FieldMask": self._mask(req.fields)}
        body: Dict[str, Any] = {"textQuery": req.query, "pageSize": min(20, max(1, req.limit))}
        if req.language:
            body["languageCode"] = req.language
        if req.location.get("country_code"):
            body["regionCode"] = req.location["country_code"].upper()

        leads: List[Lead] = []
        token = None
        pages = 0
        while len(leads) < req.limit:
            self.limiter.wait()
            if token:
                body = {"pageToken": token}
            resp = post_json(url, body=body, headers=headers, provider=self.name)
            for item in resp.get("places", []) or []:
                leads.append(self._place(item, req))
                if len(leads) >= req.limit:
                    break
            token = resp.get("nextPageToken")
            pages += 1
            if not token or pages >= 3:  # Google caps a text query at 3 pages / 60 results
                break
        return SearchResult(leads=leads, query=req.query, exhausted=not token)

class OutscraperProvider(Provider):
    name = "outscraper"
    label = "Outscraper"
    env_keys = ("OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY",)
    homepage = "https://outscraper.com"
    per_query_cap = 200

    def validate(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            return False, "OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY is empty"
        resp = get_json("https://api.outscraper.com/maps/search",
                        params={"query": "cafe in London", "limit": 1, "api_key": key},
                        provider=self.name, retries=1, timeout=30)
        items = resp.get("data", []) if isinstance(resp, dict) else resp
        return True, f"maps/search reachable - test query returned {len(items or [])} place(s)"

    def _place(self, raw: Dict[str, Any], req: SearchRequest) -> Lead:
        lead = _blank()
        lat, lon = raw.get("latitude"), raw.get("longitude")
        pid = raw.get("place_id", "")
        lead.update({
            "name": _clean(raw.get("title")),
            "place_id": pid,
            "maps_url": raw.get("place_url") or maps_link(pid, lat, lon),
            "category": _clean(raw.get("category")),
            "address": _clean(raw.get("full_address") or raw.get("address")),
            "street": _clean(raw.get("address")),
            "city": _clean(raw.get("city")),
            "region": _clean(raw.get("state")),
            "postal_code": _clean(raw.get("zip_code")),
            "country": _clean(raw.get("country")),
            "country_code": _clean(raw.get("country_code")),
            "latitude": lat,
            "longitude": lon,
            "phone": _clean(raw.get("phone")),
            "website": _clean(raw.get("website")),
            "email": _clean(raw.get("email")),
            "whatsapp": _clean(raw.get("whatsapp")),
            "facebook": _clean(raw.get("facebook")),
            "instagram": _clean(raw.get("instagram")),
            "linkedin": _clean(raw.get("linkedin")),
            "rating": raw.get("rating"),
            "reviews": raw.get("reviews"),
            "price_level": _clean(raw.get("price")),
            "logo_url": _clean(raw.get("logo")),
            "is_chain": raw.get("is_chain"),
            "chain_name": _clean(raw.get("chain_name")),
            "photos_count": raw.get("photos"),
            "year_established": raw.get("year_established"),
            "employees": raw.get("employees"),
        })
        if raw.get("address_info"):
            info = raw["address_info"]
            lead["region"] = _clean(info.get("state") or lead["region"])
            lead["postal_code"] = _clean(info.get("zip_code") or lead["postal_code"])
        return lead

    def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResult:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            raise ApiError("OUTSCRAPER_API_KEY is not set", provider=self.name)
        self.limiter.wait()
        resp = get_json(
            "https://api.outscraper.com/maps/search",
            params={
                "query": req.query,
                "limit": min(req.limit, self.per_query_cap),
                "language": req.language,
                "api_key": key,
            },
            provider=self.name,
        )
        items = resp.get("data", []) if isinstance(resp, dict) else resp
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            items = []
        leads = [self._place(i, req) for i in items if isinstance(i, dict)]
        return SearchResult(leads=leads, query=req.query, exhausted=len(leads) < req.limit)

    def enrich(self, leads: Sequence[Lead], req: SearchRequest) -> int:
        """Optional: pull e-mail / socials for leads that lack them (costs credits)."""
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            return 0
        targets = [l for l in leads if l.get("place_id") and not l.get("email")][:50]
        if not targets:
            return 0
        try:
            self.limiter.wait()
            resp = get_json(
                "https://api.outscraper.com/customers/leads-list",
                params={"placeIds": ",".join(l["place_id"] for l in targets), "api_key": key},
                provider=self.name,
            )
        except ApiError:
            return 0
        items = resp.get("data", []) if isinstance(resp, dict) else resp
        index = {l["place_id"]: l for l in leads}
        hits = 0
        for item in items or []:
            target = index.get(item.get("placeId") or item.get("place_id"))
            if not target:
                continue
            for src, dst in (("emails", "email"), ("facebookLinks", "facebook"),
                             ("instagramLinks", "instagram"), ("linkedinLinks", "linkedin")):
                vals = item.get(src) or []
                if not target.get(dst):
                    if isinstance(vals, dict):
                        val = vals.get("value") or next(iter(vals.values()), "")
                    elif isinstance(vals, list) and vals:
                        val = vals[0]
                    else:
                        val = vals
                    if isinstance(val, str) and val.strip():
                        target[dst] = val.strip()
                        hits += 1
            contacts = item.get("contacts") or []
            if contacts and not target.get("email"):
                for c in contacts:
                    if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("email"):
                        target["email"] = c["email"]
                        hits += 1
                        break
        return hits

class SerpApiProvider(Provider):
    name = "serpapi"
    label = "SerpApi"
    env_keys = ("SERPAPI_API_KEY",)
    homepage = "https://serpapi.com/google-maps-api"
    per_query_cap = 140

    def validate(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            return False, "SERPAPI_API_KEY is empty"
        resp = get_json("https://serpapi.com/search.json",
                        params={"engine": "google_maps", "q": "cafe in London",
                                "limit": 1, "api_key": key},
                        provider=self.name, retries=1, timeout=30)
        n = len(resp.get("local_results", []) or [])
        return True, f"google_maps engine reachable - test query returned {n} local result(s)"

    def _place(self, raw: Dict[str, Any], req: SearchRequest) -> Lead:
        lead = _blank()
        gps = raw.get("gps_coordinates") or {}
        pid = raw.get("place_id", "")
        lead.update({
            "name": _clean(raw.get("title")),
            "place_id": pid,
            "maps_url": _clean(raw.get("place_id_link")) or maps_link(pid),
            "category": _clean(raw.get("type")),
            "subcategory": _clean(raw.get("types")),
            "address": _clean(raw.get("address")),
            "city": _clean(raw.get("address") or "").split(",")[-1].strip(),
            "country": _clean(req.location.get("country", "")),
            "country_code": _clean(req.location.get("country_code", "")),
            "latitude": gps.get("latitude"),
            "longitude": gps.get("longitude"),
            "phone": _clean(raw.get("phone")),
            "website": _clean(raw.get("website")),
            "rating": raw.get("rating"),
            "reviews": raw.get("reviews"),
            "price_level": _clean(raw.get("price")),
            "status": "OPERATIONAL" if raw.get("open_state") != "Closed" else "CLOSED",
        })
        parts = [p.strip() for p in _clean(raw.get("address", "")).split(",") if p.strip()]
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            lead["address"] = ", ".join(parts[:-1]) if len(parts) > 2 else _clean(raw.get("address"))
        lead["region"] = parts[-2] if len(parts) >= 3 else ""
        if raw.get("open_state"):
            lead["open_now"] = "Open" in str(raw.get("open_state"))
        if raw.get("distance"):
            lead["distance"] = raw.get("distance")
        return lead

    def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResult:
        key = self.api_key()
        if not key:
            raise ApiError("SERPAPI_API_KEY is not set", provider=self.name)
        leads: List[Lead] = []
        page = 0
        exhausted = True
        while len(leads) < req.limit and page < 10:
            self.limiter.wait()
            resp = get_json(
                "https://serpapi.com/search.json",
                params={
                    "engine": "google_maps",
                    "type": "search",
                    "q": req.query,
                    "hl": req.language or "en",
                    "gl": req.location.get("country_code", ""),
                    "page": page,
                    "api_key": key,
                },
                provider=self.name,
            )
            items = resp.get("local_results") or []
            if not items:
                break
            for item in items:
                leads.append(self._place(item, req))
                if len(leads) >= req.limit:
                    exhausted = False
                    break
            pagination = resp.get("local_results_pagination") or {}
            if pagination.get("next_page") or pagination.get("next"):
                page += 1
                exhausted = False
            else:
                break
        return SearchResult(leads=leads, query=req.query, exhausted=exhausted)

    "us": 2840, "ca": 2076, "gb": 2826, "au": 2039, "in": 2032, "de": 2756,
    "fr": 2074, "es": 2724, "it": 2759, "nl": 2789, "br": 2076, "mx": 2014,

# DataForSEO has moved this endpoint between products; try each until one sticks.
DFS_ENDPOINTS = (
    "https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/maps/live/advanced",
    "https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/business_data/google/maps/live/advanced",

class DataForSeoProvider(Provider):
    name = "dataforseo"
    label = "DataForSEO"
    env_keys = ("DATAFORSEO_LOGIN", "DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD")
    homepage = "https://dataforseo.com/apis/google-maps-api"
    per_query_cap = 300

    def __init__(self, **config):
        super().__init__(**config)
        self._auth: Optional[str] = None
        self._locations: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None

    def _basic_auth(self) -> str:
        if self._auth is None:
            import base64
            login = os.environ.get("DATAFORSEO_LOGIN", "")
            password = os.environ.get("DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD", "")
            if not login or not password:
                raise ApiError("DATAFORSEO_LOGIN / DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD are not set",
                               provider=self.name)
            self._auth = base64.b64encode(f"{login}:{password}".encode()).decode()
        return self._auth

    def location_code(self, country_code: str) -> int:
        """Country ISO -> DataForSEO location_code (API appendix first, table fallback)."""
        cc = (country_code or "").lower()
        if self._locations is None:
            self._locations = dict(DFS_LOCATION_CODES)
            try:
                resp = get_json(
                    "https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/locations",
                    params={"limit": 1000},
                    headers={"Authorization": f"Basic {self._basic_auth()}"},
                    provider=self.name, retries=1, timeout=25,
                )
                for item in resp.get("results", []) or []:
                    code = item.get("location_code")
                    if code is None:
                        continue
                    for c in item.get("country_code", []) or []:
                        self._locations.setdefault(str(c).lower(), int(code))
            except (ApiError, ValueError, TypeError):
                pass
        return self._locations.get(cc, 2840)

    def validate(self) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
        auth = f"Basic {self._basic_auth()}"
        resp = get_json("https://api.dataforseo.com/v3/appendix/user_data",
                        headers={"Authorization": auth},
                        provider=self.name, retries=1, timeout=30)
        login = (resp.get("login") or "?")
        balance = resp.get("money", {}).get("balance")
        return True, f"credentials OK for login '{login}'" + (
            f" - account balance ${balance}" if balance is not None else "")

    def _place(self, raw: Dict[str, Any], req: SearchRequest) -> Lead:
        lead = _blank()
        addr = raw.get("address_info") or {}
        coords = raw.get("coordinates") or {}
        pid = str(raw.get("place_id") or "")
        lead.update({
            "name": _clean(raw.get("title")),
            "place_id": pid,
            "maps_url": _clean(raw.get("url")) or maps_link(pid),
            "category": _clean(raw.get("category")),
            "address": _clean(raw.get("address")),
            "street": _clean(addr.get("street_address") or addr.get("address_line1")),
            "city": _clean(addr.get("city")),
            "region": _clean(addr.get("region")),
            "postal_code": _clean(addr.get("zip_code") or addr.get("post_code")),
            "country": _clean(addr.get("country_name")),
            "country_code": _clean(addr.get("country_code")).upper(),
            "latitude": coords.get("latitude"),
            "longitude": coords.get("longitude"),
            "phone": _clean(raw.get("phone")),
            "website": _clean(raw.get("url_2") or raw.get("domain")),
            "rating": raw.get("rating"),
            "reviews": raw.get("reviews_count"),
            "price_level": _clean(raw.get("price")),
            "is_chain": raw.get("is_claimed"),
        })
        cid = raw.get("cid")
        if cid:
            lead["maps_url"] = f"https://www.google.com/maps?cid={cid}"
        return lead

    def search(self, req: SearchRequest) -> SearchResult:
        auth = f"Basic {self._basic_auth()}"
        code = self.location_code(req.location.get("country_code", ""))
        task = [{
            "keyword": req.query,
            "language_code": req.language or "en",
            "location_code": code,
            "limit": min(req.limit, self.per_query_cap),
            "depth": 1,
        }]
        if req.extras.get("df_location_code"):
            task[0]["location_code"] = int(req.extras["df_location_code"])

        headers = {"Authorization": auth}
        last_error: Optional[ApiError] = None
        resp: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for endpoint in DFS_ENDPOINTS:
            self.limiter.wait()
            try:
                resp = post_json(endpoint, body=[task], headers=headers, provider=self.name)
            except ApiError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if exc.status and exc.status != 404:
                    raise
                continue
            if str(resp.get("status_code", "")) == "40400":
                last_error = ApiError("endpoint not available", 404, self.name, resp)
                continue
            break
        else:
            raise last_error or ApiError("no DataForSEO maps endpoint responded", provider=self.name)

        tasks = resp.get("tasks") or []
        if not tasks:
            return SearchResult(leads=[], query=req.query, exhausted=True)
        status = tasks[0].get("status_code")
        if status and status != 20000:
            raise ApiError(tasks[0].get("status_message", "unknown error"),
                           status, self.name, resp)
        results = tasks[0].get("result") or []
        items = results[0].get("items") if results else []
        leads = [self._place(i, req) for i in (items or []) if isinstance(i, dict)]
        total = results[0].get("se_domain", 0) if results else 0
        return SearchResult(leads=leads, query=req.query,
                            exhausted=len(leads) < req.limit, raw_total=total)

        raise KeyError(f"unknown provider '{name}'. choose one of: {', '.join(PROVIDERS)}")

    return [n for n in ORDER if PROVIDERS[n].is_configured()]

    """Pick the best provider for the keys present on this machine."""
    if prefer:
        return prefer if PROVIDERS[prefer].is_configured() else None
    found = configured_providers()
    return found[0] if found else None

"""
MAPLEAD interactive terminal UI: prompts, menus, tables, progress.
Pure stdlib - works over ssh, in pipes, and in dumb terminals.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import sys
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, Sequence

from . import art
from .art import GLYPH, PLAIN, _strip_ansi, c, panel, section  # noqa: F401  (re-exported)

# names this module re-exports from .art for the CLI's convenience
__all__ = [
    "GLYPH", "PLAIN", "art", "c", "panel", "section", "_strip_ansi",
    "term_size", "out", "raw_in", "vwidth", "pad", "trunc", "n_columns",
    "col_width", "page_fit", "grid", "step", "hint", "warn", "error", "ok",
    "info", "ask_text", "ask_number", "ask_choice", "ask_multiselect",
    "ask_yesno", "table", "Progress", "clear_screen",
]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# low level io
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

WIDTH = min(art.term_width(), 110)
COL_GAP = 4


def term_size() -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(width, height) of the terminal, with sane fallbacks."""
    try:
        size = shutil.get_terminal_size((96, 24))
        return max(48, size.columns), max(10, size.lines)
    except Exception:
        return 96, 24


def out(text: str = "") -> None:
    sys.stdout.write(text + "\n")
    sys.stdout.flush()


def raw_in(prompt: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        sys.stdout.write(prompt)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if line == "":
            return None
        return line.rstrip("\n").rstrip("\r")
    except (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):
        out()
        return None


def vwidth(text: str) -> int:
    return len(_strip_ansi(text))


def pad(text: str, width: int, align: str = "left") -> str:
    gap = max(0, width - vwidth(text))
    if align == "right":
        return " " * gap + text
    if align == "center":
        return " " * (gap // 2) + text + " " * (gap - gap // 2)
    return text + " " * gap


def trunc(text: str, width: int) -> str:
    text = str(text if text is not None else "")
    if vwidth(text) <= width:
        return text
    if width <= 1:
        return "…"
    return text[: width - 1] + "…"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# multi-column layout (keeps long lists on one screen - no endless scrolling)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def n_columns(count: int, min_col: int = 30, max_cols: int = 3) -> int:
    """How many columns of `min_col` chars still fit in the terminal."""
    avail = max(24, WIDTH - 3)
    n = 1
    while n < min(count, max_cols) and (n + 1) * (min_col + COL_GAP) - COL_GAP <= avail:
        n += 1
    return n


def col_width(ncols: int, min_col: int = 30) -> int:
    """Printable width of one column once `ncols` of them share the line."""
    avail = max(24, WIDTH - 3)
    return max(10, (avail - COL_GAP * (ncols - 1)) // ncols)


def page_fit(ncols: int, lines_per_item: int = 1, reserve: int = 11) -> int:
    """How many items fit on one screen, so a list needs no scrolling."""
    rows = max(3, (term_size()[1] - reserve) // max(1, lines_per_item))
    return max(6, rows * ncols)


def grid(cells: Sequence[str], min_col: int = 30, max_cols: int = 3,
         indent: str = "   ") -> list[str]:
    """
    Lay out cells side by side, left to right, then top to bottom.

    Every cell may hold several lines ("label\\nsub-label") - the rows are
    aligned so the columns stay visually straight. Cell *i* lands in column
    i % ncols, so keeping the numbering in step with `cells` keeps the
    reading order left-to-right as well.
    """
    if not cells:
        return []
    ncols = n_columns(len(cells), min_col, max_cols)
    if ncols == 1:
        return [indent + line for cell in cells for line in cell.split("\n")]

    width = col_width(ncols, min_col)
    blocks = [cell.split("\n") for cell in cells]
    lines: list[str] = []
    for start in range(0, len(blocks), ncols):
        row = blocks[start:start + ncols]
        height = max(len(b) for b in row)
        for r in range(height):
            parts = [pad(trunc(b[r] if r < len(b) else "", width), width) for b in row]
            lines.append(indent + (" " * COL_GAP).join(parts).rstrip())
    return lines


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# prompt widgets
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def step(n: int, total: int, title: str) -> None:
    """Print a numbered step header."""
    tag = c(f"[{n}/{total}]", "yellow", bold=True)
    out()
    out(f" {tag} {c(title.upper(), 'white', bold=True)}")


def hint(text: str) -> None:
    out(f"   {c(text, 'white', dim=True)}")


def warn(text: str) -> None:
    out(f"   {c(GLYPH['warn'], 'yellow')} {c(text, 'yellow')}")


def error(text: str) -> None:
    out(f"   {c(GLYPH['cross'], 'red')} {c(text, 'red')}")


def ok(text: str) -> None:
    out(f"   {c(GLYPH['check'], 'green')} {c(text, 'green')}")


def info(text: str) -> None:
    out(f"   {c(GLYPH['bullet'], 'cyan')} {text}")


def ask_text(question: str, default: str = "", placeholder: str = "",
              required: bool = False, allow_skip: bool = False) -> str:
    """Free-text input with default + placeholder ghosting."""
    while True:
        label = c(question, "white")
        if default:
            label += c(f" [{default}]", "white", dim=True)
        elif placeholder:
            label += c(f" ({placeholder})", "white", dim=True)
        if allow_skip:
            label += c("   (enter = skip)", "white", dim=True)
        raw = raw_in(f"   {label} {GLYPH['arrow']} ")
        if raw is None:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            if default:
                return default
            if not required or allow_skip:
                return ""
            error("this one is required - type a value or press enter to skip")
            continue
        return raw


def ask_number(question: str, default: int, minimum: int = 1,
               maximum: int = 100_000, suffix: str = "") -> int:
    while True:
        label = c(question, "white") + c(f" [{default}{suffix}]", "white", dim=True)
        raw = raw_in(f"   {label} {GLYPH['arrow']} ")
        if raw is None:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            return default
        try:
            val = int(raw.replace(" ", "").replace("k", "000"))
        except ValueError:
            error(f"'{raw}' is not a number")
            continue
        if val < minimum or val > maximum:
            error(f"please pick between {minimum} and {maximum}")
            continue
        return val


def ask_choice(question: str, items: Sequence[Any],
               labeler: Callable[[Any], str] | None = None,
               default_index: int = 0, page: int = 0,
               sublabeler: Callable[[Any], str] | None = None,
               extra: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = (),
               min_col: int = 30, max_cols: int = 3) -> Any:
    """
    Numbered picker with type-to-filter, laid out in as many columns as fit.
      - number            -> choose
      - substring         -> filter the list (a single remaining match auto-selects)
      - any of `extra`    -> e.g. "other" / "__custom__"

    page=0 means "size the page to the terminal", which is what stops the long
    catalogues (65 countries, 68 verticals) from turning into a scroll marathon.
    """
    labeler = labeler or (lambda x: str(x))
    sublabeler = sublabeler or (lambda x: "")
    extra_keys = [k for k, _ in extra]

    # how much room one item needs -> how many fit on screen
    probe = list(items)[:60]
    per_item = 2 if any(sublabeler(it) for it in probe) else 1
    ncols = n_columns(len(items), min_col, max_cols)
    colw = col_width(ncols, min_col)
    limit = page if page > 0 else page_fit(ncols, per_item)

    term = ""
    while True:
        matches = items
        if term:
            needle = term.lower()
            matches = [it for it in items
                       if needle in labeler(it).lower()
                       or (sublabeler(it) and needle in sublabeler(it).lower())]
        out()
        out(f"   {c(question, 'white', bold=True)}")
        if term:
            out(f"   {c(f'filter: {term!r}', 'yellow')} "
                f"{c('(clear: .)', 'white', dim=True)}")
        if not matches:
            error("nothing matches that filter - press . to clear it")
            term = ""
            continue
        if term and len(matches) == 1:
            hit = matches[0]
            ok(f"selected {c(labeler(hit), 'yellow', bold=True)}"
               + (f"  {c(sublabeler(hit), 'white', dim=True)}" if sublabeler(hit) else ""))
            return hit

        shown = matches[:limit]
        cells = []
        for i, it in enumerate(shown, 1):
            num = c(f"{i:>2}", "cyan", bold=True)
            cell = f"{num} {trunc(labeler(it), colw)}"
            sub = sublabeler(it)
            if sub:
                cell += "\n   " + trunc(sub, colw)
            cells.append(cell)
        for line in grid(cells, min_col=min_col, max_cols=max_cols):
            out(line)
        if len(matches) > len(shown):
            hidden = len(matches) - len(shown)
            out(f"   {c(f'… {hidden} more match' + ('es' if hidden != 1 else ''), 'white', dim=True)}"
                f" {c(f'({len(matches)} total - keep typing to narrow it)', 'white', dim=True)}")
        out(f"   {c('· type text to filter', 'white', dim=True)}")

        for key, desc in extra:
            out(f"   {c('  ·', 'green')} {c(key, 'green', bold=True)} {c(desc, 'white', dim=True)}")

        tip = f"#{default_index + 1}" if not term else "#"
        raw = raw_in(f"   {c(tip, 'white', dim=True)} {GLYPH['arrow']} ")
        if raw is None:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            return matches[min(default_index, len(matches) - 1)]
        if raw == ".":
            term = ""
            continue
        if raw in extra_keys:
            return raw
        if raw.isdigit():
            idx = int(raw) - 1
            if 0 <= idx < len(shown):
                return shown[idx]
            error(f"pick between 1 and {len(shown)}")
            continue
        term = raw
        default_index = 0


def _parse_selection(raw: str, names: Sequence[str]) -> list[int] | None:
    """Parse '1,3-5,all,none,rec,name substring'. None => invalid."""
    raw = raw.strip().lower()
    if raw in ("all", "a", "*"):
        return list(range(len(names)))
    if raw in ("none", "n", "-"):
        return []
    picks: list[int] = []
    for chunk in raw.replace(" ", "").split(","):
        if not chunk:
            continue
        if "-" in chunk and not chunk.startswith("-"):
            a, _, b = chunk.partition("-")
            if a.isdigit() and b.isdigit():
                lo, hi = int(a), int(b)
                picks.extend(range(max(lo, 1) - 1, min(hi, len(names))))
                continue
        if chunk.isdigit():
            n = int(chunk)
            if 1 <= n <= len(names):
                picks.append(n - 1)
                continue
            return None
        hits = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if chunk in n.lower()]
        if not hits:
            return None
        picks.extend(hits)
    seen, out_ = set(), []
    for p in picks:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            out_.append(p)
    return out_


def ask_multiselect(question: str, items: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
                    recommended: Sequence[str] = (),
                    page: int = 0,
                    presets: Sequence[tuple[str, str, Sequence[str]]] = (),
                    min_col: int = 46, max_cols: int = 2) -> list[str]:
    """
    items: sequence of (key, label). recommended: subset of keys.
    Accepts: 1,4-9 / all / none / rec / keyword / .  (clear)
    presets: sequence of (token, description, keys) e.g. ('rec', 'recommended', (...))
    Rendered in columns, sized to the terminal.
    """
    names = [k for k, _ in items]
    labels = dict(items)
    defaults = [k for k in names if k in recommended] or names
    preset_map = {token: list(keys) for token, _, keys in presets}

    ncols = n_columns(len(items), min_col, max_cols)
    colw = col_width(ncols, min_col)
    limit = page if page > 0 else page_fit(ncols, 1, reserve=9)

    while True:
        out()
        out(f"   {c(question, 'white', bold=True)}")
        out(f"   {c('default =', 'white', dim=True)} {c(','.join(defaults), 'yellow')}")
        shown = names[:limit]
        cells = []
        text_w = max(8, colw - 5)          # 2 for the number, 2 for the "*" mark
        for i, k in enumerate(shown, 1):
            mark = c(f"{i:>2}", "cyan", bold=True)
            star = c(" *", "yellow", bold=True) if k in recommended else "  "
            cells.append(f"{mark} " + pad(trunc(labels[k], text_w), text_w) + star)
        for line in grid(cells, min_col=min_col, max_cols=max_cols):
            out(line)
        if len(names) > len(shown):
            out(f"   {c(f'… {len(names) - len(shown)} more (use all / rec / a range)', 'white', dim=True)}")
        chips = [("all", "everything"), ("none", "empty")] + \
                [(tok, desc) for tok, desc, _ in presets]
        out("   ".join(f"{c('·', 'green')} {c(t, 'green', bold=True)} "
                       f"{c(d, 'white', dim=True)}" for t, d in chips))
        raw = raw_in(f"   {c(','.join(defaults)[:40], 'white', dim=True)} {GLYPH['arrow']} ")
        if raw is None:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw or raw.lower() in ("rec", "recommended"):
            return list(defaults)
        if raw.lower() in preset_map:
            return list(preset_map[raw.lower()])
        sel = _parse_selection(raw, names)
        if sel is None:
            error("could not parse that - try: 1,3-5  or  all  or  rec  or a keyword")
            continue
        return [names[i] for i in sel]


def ask_yesno(question: str, default: bool = True) -> bool:
    opts = "Y/n" if default else "y/N"
    while True:
        raw = raw_in(f"   {c(question, 'white')} {c('[' + opts + ']', 'white', dim=True)} {GLYPH['arrow']} ")
        if raw is None:
            raise KeyboardInterrupt
        raw = raw.strip().lower()
        if not raw:
            return default
        if raw in ("y", "yes"):
            return True
        if raw in ("n", "no"):
            return False
        error("answer y or n")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# tables
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def table(headers: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Sequence[Any]],
          aligns: Sequence[str] | None = None, max_width: int | None = None,
          head_color: str = "cyan") -> str:
    """Compact column-aligned table (ANSI aware, truncates to terminal width)."""
    if not rows:
        return c("   (nothing to show)", "white", dim=True)
    cols = len(headers)
    aligns = list(aligns or ["left"] * cols)
    budget = max_width or WIDTH - 4

    data = [[("" if v is None else str(v)) for v in r] for r in rows]
    widths = [max(vwidth(h), *(vwidth(r[i]) for r in data)) if data else vwidth(h)
              for i, h in enumerate(headers) for _ in [0]]
    widths = []
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        w = vwidth(h)
        for r in data:
            w = max(w, vwidth(r[i]))
        widths.append(w)

    gap = 2
    while sum(widths) + gap * (cols - 1) > budget:
        widest = max(range(cols), key=lambda i: widths[i])
        if widths[widest] <= 8:
            break
        widths[widest] -= 1

    out_lines = []
    head = "   " + "  ".join(c(pad(trunc(h, widths[i]), widths[i], "center"),
                               head_color, bold=True) for i, h in enumerate(headers))
    out_lines.append(head)
    out_lines.append("   " + c(GLYPH["h"] * (min(sum(widths) + gap * (cols - 1), budget)), "cyan", dim=True))
    for r in data:
        cells = []
        for i in range(cols):
            cells.append(pad(trunc(r[i], widths[i]), widths[i], aligns[i]))
        out_lines.append("   " + c("  ", "cyan", dim=True).join(cells))
    return "\n".join(out_lines)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# progress
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

class Progress:
    """Single-line live progress. Degrades to periodic lines when piped."""

    def __init__(self, label: str = "working", total: int | None = None):
        self.label = label
        self.total = total
        self.n = 0
        self.live = sys.stdout.isatty()
        self.t0 = time.time()
        self._i = 0
        self._last = 0.0
        self._lastline = ""

    def advance(self, amount: int = 1, note: str = "") -> None:
        self.n += amount
        self._render(note)

    def update(self, note: str = "") -> None:
        self._render(note)

    def _render(self, note: str) -> None:
        if not self.live or PLAIN:
            now = time.time()
            if now - self._last < 1.0 and self.n != (self.total or 0):
                return
            self._last = now
            tail = f"  {note}" if note else ""
            out(f"   {c(GLYPH['dot'], 'cyan')} {self.label}{tail}")
            return
        now = time.time()
        if now - self._last < 0.08:
            return
        self._last = now
        self._i += 1
        sp = art.spinner(self._i)
        cnt = f"{self.n}/{self.total}" if self.total else f"{self.n}"
        line = f"   {c(sp, 'cyan')} {self.label}  {c(cnt, 'yellow', bold=True)}{('  ' + note) if note else ''}"
        width = max(0, WIDTH - vwidth(line))
        self._lastline = line
        sys.stdout.write("\r" + line + " " * width)
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def done(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        self._render("")
        if self.live and not PLAIN:
            sys.stdout.write("\r" + " " * (WIDTH + 4) + "\r")
            sys.stdout.flush()
        if message:
            out(f"   {c(GLYPH['check'], 'green')} {c(message, 'green')}")

    def stop(self) -> None:
        if self.live and not PLAIN and self._lastline:
            sys.stdout.write("\r" + " " * (WIDTH + 4) + "\r")
            sys.stdout.flush()


def clear_screen() -> None:
    sys.stdout.write("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")
    sys.stdout.flush()

"""
Frozen entry point for the PyInstaller build.

Kept separate from maplead-gui.py so the frozen binary has one obvious main and
so `--windowed` mode still shows errors on stderr when MAPLEAD_DEBUG is set.
"""

import multiprocessing
import os
import sys


def _entry() -> int:
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        multiprocessing.freeze_support()      # harmless, but keeps Qt threads happy
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING", "1")
    from maplead.gui.app import main
    return main()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(_entry())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# MAPLEAD launcher.
#
# Runs the AppImage the normal way when the system has FUSE (libfuse.so.2).
# When it does not - containers, servers, distros that ship FUSE 3 only - it
# unpacks the image once into @CACHE@ and runs straight from there, so there
# is no FUSE, no loop device and no root anywhere in the picture.
#
#   maplead                  normal start
#   maplead --selftest       headless self-check
#   MAPLEAD_NO_FUSE=1 ...    always take the unpacked path
#
set -u

APP="@APP@"
CACHE="@CACHE@"

have_fuse() {
    case "${MAPLEAD_NO_FUSE:-0}" in
        1|true|yes|on) return 1 ;;
    esac
    if command -v ldconfig >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'libfuse\.so\.2' && return 0
        return 1
    fi
    local dir
    for dir in /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib64 \
               /usr/local/lib /lib /usr/lib /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu; do
        if [ -e "$dir/libfuse.so.2" ]; then
            return 0
        fi
    done
    return 1
}

unpack() {
    local tmp
    tmp="$(mktemp -d)" || return 1
    ( cd "$tmp" && "$APP" --appimage-extract >/dev/null 2>&1 ) || { rm -rf "$tmp"; return 1; }
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CACHE")" || { rm -rf "$tmp"; return 1; }
    rm -rf "$CACHE"
    mv "$tmp/squashfs-root" "$CACHE" || { rm -rf "$tmp"; return 1; }
    rm -rf "$tmp"
    return 0
}

if [ ! -f "$APP" ]; then
    echo "MAPLEAD: app image not found: $APP" >&2
    echo "         rebuild it with:  ~/maplead/build-appimage.sh" >&2
    exit 127
fi

if have_fuse; then
    exec "$APP" "$@"
fi

# no libfuse2: unpack once (fast, ~1s) and reuse the copy afterwards
if [ ! -x "$CACHE/AppRun" ] || [ "$APP" -nt "$CACHE/AppRun" ]; then
    if ! unpack; then
        echo "MAPLEAD: could not unpack $APP" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

exec "$CACHE/AppRun" "$@"

"""
Rasterise packaging/maplead.svg into the PNG sizes an AppImage/desktop menu wants.

    python packaging/render_icon.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SVG = os.path.join(HERE, "maplead.svg")
SIZES = (256, 512, 1024)


def main() -> int:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QByteArray, QSize, Qt
    from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QPainter
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from PySide6.QtSvg import QSvgRenderer

    app = QApplication(sys.argv[:1])              # noqa: F841 - needed by Qt
    renderer = QSvgRenderer(QByteArray(open(SVG, "rb").read()))
    if not renderer.isValid():
        print(f"invalid SVG: {SVG}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    for size in SIZES:
        image = QImage(QSize(size, size), QImage.Format_ARGB32)
        image.fill(Qt.transparent)
        painter = QPainter(image)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
        renderer.render(painter)
        painter.end()
        target = os.path.join(HERE, f"maplead-{size}.png")
        if not image.save(target, "PNG"):
            print(f"failed to write {target}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print(f"  {target}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
Publish the repository to GitHub over the REST API.

Useful when this machine has no system-wide git and no FUSE-free SSH client —
which is exactly the case on a locked-down desktop: all this needs is `curl`
and a Personal Access Token.

    # one-off
    python tools/publish.py --token ghp_xxx --repo maplead

    # safer: keep the token out of the shell history
    read -rs TOKEN && printf '%s' "$TOKEN" > ~/.maplead-github-token && chmod 600 ~/.maplead-github-token
    python tools/publish.py --repo maplead          # reads the file above
    rm -f ~/.maplead-github-token

What it does: creates the repository (if missing), uploads every tracked file
through the git-data API (blobs for binaries, inline content for text), then
creates the commit and points ``main`` at it. Re-running is safe: it detects an
existing repository and only updates the branch when the tree differs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import json
import mimetypes
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
TOKEN_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.maplead-github-token")
API = "https://api.github.com"
DESCRIPTION = (
    "Interactive Google Maps lead extractor. Desktop app for Linux (single-file AppImage, Qt6) + a zero-dependency terminal wizard, both on the same engine: 4 lead APIs, 65 countries, 68 business verticals, 35 fields, 6 export formats."
)

TOPICS = ["leads", "google-maps", "scraper", "qt6", "appimage", "linux",
          "business-directory", "outscraper", "serpapi", "python"]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# plumbing
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def get_token(arg: str | None) -> str:
    """--token, then GITHUB_TOKEN, then ~/.maplead-github-token, then `gh auth`."""
    token = arg or os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "").strip()
    if not token and os.path.exists(TOKEN_FILE):
        with open(TOKEN_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            token = fh.read().strip()
    if not token:
        try:                                   # reuse an existing `gh auth login`
            token = subprocess.run(["gh", "auth", "token"],
                                   capture_output=True, text=True,
                                   check=True).stdout.strip()
        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
            token = ""
    if not token:
        sys.exit("no token: pass --token, set GITHUB_TOKEN, write " + TOKEN_FILE
                 + ", or run `gh auth login`")
    return token


def call(method: str, url: str, token: str, payload=None, accept="application/vnd.github+json"):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers={
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Accept": accept,
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
        "User-Agent": "maplead-publish",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    })
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
            return json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        detail = exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
        try:
            detail = json.loads(detail).get("message", detail)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        raise SystemExit(f"{method} {url} -> HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from None


def tracked_files() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """(relative path, absolute path) for everything git would commit."""
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "ls-files", "-z"],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        sys.exit("git not available, or this is not a repository yet")
    return [(rel, os.path.join(ROOT, rel)) for rel in out.split("\0") if rel]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# steps
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def ensure_repo(token: str, repo: str, private: bool) -> dict:
    """Create the repository; tolerate 'already exists'."""
    try:
        return call("POST", f"{API}/user/repos", token, {
            "name": repo,
            "description": DESCRIPTION,
            "private": private,
            "auto_init": False,
            "has_wiki": False,
            "has_issues": True,
            "topics": TOPICS,
        })
    except SystemExit as exc:
        text = str(exc)
        if "HTTP 422" not in text and "already exists" not in text:
            raise                      # 422 on create == the name is taken
        print("  repository already exists, continuing")
        return call("GET", f"{API}/repos/{login(token)}/{repo}", token)


def login(token: str) -> str:
    return call("GET", f"{API}/user", token)["login"]


def upload_tree(token: str, owner: str, repo: str, files) -> str:
    """One tree request; binaries go up as separate base64 blobs."""
    entries, blobs = [], {}
    for rel, path in files:
        raw = open(path, "rb").read()
        guessed = mimetypes.guess_type(rel)[0] or ""
        if raw[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" or guessed.startswith("image/"):
            blobs[rel] = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
        else:
            try:
                entries.append({"path": rel, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob",
                                "content": raw.decode("utf-8")})
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                blobs[rel] = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()

    for rel, b64 in blobs.items():
        sha = call("POST", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/blobs", token,
                   {"content": b64, "encoding": "base64"})["sha"]
        entries.append({"path": rel, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", "sha": sha})
        print(f"    blob {rel}")

    tree = call("POST", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees", token,
                {"tree": entries})
    if tree.get("truncated"):
        sys.exit("tree came back truncated - too many files for one request")
    print(f"  tree: {len(entries)} entries")
    return tree["sha"]


def seed_if_empty(token: str, owner: str, repo: str) -> None:
    """The git-data API refuses blobs on a repository with no commits.

    Creating one placeholder commit through the contents API unblocks it.
    """
    try:
        call("GET", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/main", token)
        return                                   # main already exists
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    print("  seeding empty repository…")
    call("PUT", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/.gitkeep", token, {
        "message": "init",
        "content": base64.b64encode(b"").decode(),
        "branch": "main",
    })


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--repo", required=True, help="repository name, e.g. maplead")
    ap.add_argument("--token", help="PAT with the 'repo' scope")
    ap.add_argument("--private", action="store_true", help="create it private")
    ap.add_argument("--message", default=None, help="commit message")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    token = get_token(args.token)
    user = login(token)
    owner, repo = user, args.repo
    print(f"  authenticated as {user}")

    print("  repository:")
    info = ensure_repo(token, repo, args.private)
    owner = info.get("owner", {}).get("login", owner)

    files = tracked_files()
    seed_if_empty(token, owner, repo)
    print(f"  uploading {len(files)} tracked files")
    tree_sha = upload_tree(token, owner, repo, files)

    message = args.message
    if not message:
        try:
            message = subprocess.run(
                ["git", "-C", ROOT, "log", "-1", "--pretty=%s"],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
            message = "MAPLEAD"

    parent = None
    ref = f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/ref/heads/main"
    try:
        parent = call("GET", ref, token)["object"]["sha"]
    except SystemExit:
        pass                                   # empty repository

    commit = call("POST", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits", token, {
        "message": message,
        "tree": tree_sha,
        **({"parents": [parent]} if parent else {}),
    })["sha"]

    if parent:
        call("PATCH", ref, token, {"sha": commit, "force": True})
    else:
        call("POST", f"{API}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs", token,
             {"ref": "refs/heads/main", "sha": commit})

    url = f"https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}"
    print(f"\n  published: {url}")
    print(f"  commit:    {commit[:10]}  {message}")
    print(f"\n  next:  git -C {ROOT} remote add origin {url}.git")
    print("        git -C %s fetch origin && git -C %s reset --soft origin/main" % (ROOT, ROOT))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""
Regenerate the screenshots used in the README.

Needs a real display (an X11 / Wayland session) and, for the one with real
leads in it, an API key. Everything else runs on the built-in demo provider.

    python tools/screenshots.py [output-dir]

The user's own window state (~/.config/maplead/maplead-desktop.conf) is saved
and restored, so generating the docs never disturbs their session.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

OUT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "screenshots")
SETTINGS = os.path.expanduser("~/.config/maplead/maplead-desktop.conf")

WIN_W, WIN_H = 1352, 726          # fits a 1366x768 panel


def _restore_state():
    """Keep the user's saved form/window state out of the screenshot run."""
    backup = None
    if os.path.exists(SETTINGS):
        backup = tempfile.mktemp(prefix="maplead-settings-")
        shutil.copy2(SETTINGS, backup)
    return backup


def _put_state(backup):
    if backup and os.path.exists(backup):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(SETTINGS), exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(backup, SETTINGS)
        os.remove(backup)


def _mask_keys() -> None:
    """Replace real API keys in the environment with an obviously fake one.

    The window shows a masked key (``a765dc…41dc``); publishing even that much
    of someone's live key in a repo screenshot is not worth it.
    """
    from maplead.providers import PROVIDERS

    for name in PROVIDERS:
        cls = PROVIDERS[name]
        for var in cls.env_keys:
            if os.environ.get(var):
                os.environ[var] = "0demo0fake000key0not0real0xyz1"


def _hide_keys() -> None:
    from maplead.providers import PROVIDERS

    for name in PROVIDERS:
        for var in PROVIDERS[name].env_keys:
            os.environ.pop(var, None)


def main() -> int:
    if os.environ.get("DISPLAY") and not os.environ.get("WAYLAND_DISPLAY"):
        os.environ.pop("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", None)     # real fonts, real screen
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

    from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication

    from maplead import paths
    from maplead.data import fields as FD
    from maplead.gui import app as gui_app
    from maplead.gui import theme as theme_mod
    from maplead.gui.keys import KeysDialog
    from maplead.gui.main_window import MainWindow
    from maplead.gui.widgets import FieldPickerDialog
    from maplead.gui.worker import HarvestWorker

    paths.load_env()
    backup = _restore_state()
    try:
        qapp, args = gui_app.create_app([])

        def shoot(widget, name: str, size=None, settle: float = 0.7) -> str:
            widget.show()
            if size:
                widget.resize(*size)
            QCoreApplication.processEvents()
            time.sleep(settle)
            QCoreApplication.processEvents()
            path = os.path.join(OUT, name)
            widget.grab().save(path)
            print("  ", path)
            return path

        # ---------------------------------------------------------- dark UI
        win = MainWindow(theme_mod.PALETTES["dark"])

        win.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == "serpapi")
        win.country_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda c: c.iso == "pt")
        win.city_combo.setCurrentText("Cascais")
        win.business_combo.setCurrentText("Veterinary clinic")
        win.limit_spin.setValue(40)
        win.cb_phone.setChecked(True)
        QCoreApplication.processEvents()

        if win._problems():
            # no SerpApi key available -> show honest synthetic data instead
            print("  (no live provider key: shooting with demo data)")
            win.provider_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda p: p == "demo")
            win.country_combo.setValueByPredicate(lambda c: c.iso == "de")
            win.city_combo.setCurrentText("Berlin")
            win.business_combo.setCurrentText("Veterinary clinic")
            QCoreApplication.processEvents()

        spec = win.spec()
        spec.outpath = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "maplead-shot.csv")
        state: dict = {}
        worker = HarvestWorker(spec)
        worker.finished.connect(lambda r: state.update(result=r))
        worker.failed.connect(lambda m, h: state.update(error=f"{m} {h}"))
        worker.run()
        if "error" in state:
            print("  search failed:", state["error"], file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        result = state["result"]
        win._on_finished(result)

        # a) no real key fragments, b) a realistic export path in the status bar
        _mask_keys()
        win._refresh_provider_status()
        win._on_provider_changed()
        win.status_right.setText("~/Documents/maplead/veterinary-clinic-cascais.csv")
        shoot(win, "app-dark.png", (WIN_W, WIN_H))

        # ------------------------------------------------------- light theme
        theme_mod.apply_theme(qapp, theme_mod.PALETTES["light"])
        light = MainWindow(theme_mod.PALETTES["light"])
        light._on_finished(result)
        light._refresh_provider_status()
        light._on_provider_changed()
        light.status_right.setText("~/Documents/maplead/veterinary-clinic-cascais.csv")
        shoot(light, "app-light.png", (WIN_W, WIN_H))
        theme_mod.apply_theme(qapp, theme_mod.PALETTES["dark"])

        # ------------------------------------------------------- dialogs ----
        picker = FieldPickerDialog("outscraper", list(FD.RECOMMENDED), win)
        shoot(picker, "fields.png", (720, 650))
        picker.close()

        keys = KeysDialog(theme_mod.PALETTES["dark"], win)
        shoot(keys, "api-keys.png", (740, 720))
        keys.close()

        # ------------------------------------------------- empty first run ---
        from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings
        QSettings("maplead", "maplead-desktop").clear()
        _hide_keys()          # what a brand-new machine really looks like
        fresh = MainWindow(theme_mod.PALETTES["dark"])
        shoot(fresh, "first-run.png", (WIN_W, WIN_H))
        fresh.close()
        win.close()
        light.close()
        return 0
    finally:
        _put_state(backup)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
